That's why we're pushing a big ride to the polls program, to make sure everyone can make their voice heard on Tuesday.

Can you join us in thanking President Biden for all he’s done from his start in the U.S. Senate to his final months as President? We need signatures from your community → | | |
---
| |
---|---
President Biden deserves our respect and gratitude for all he’s done and all he will continue to do as he finishes his historic term in office. Over the past four years, the Biden Administration has made a powerful impact on our country, passing progressive legislation and supporting American families:
* Creating nearly 11 million jobs – including 750,000 manufacturing jobs – and getting unemployment down to the lowest rate in 50 years
* Making record investments in infrastructure to fix our crumbling roads and bridges
* Protecting same-sex and interracial marriage with the _Respect for Marriage Act_
* Defending access to reproductive health care
* Canceling student loans for millions of borrowers
* Passing the first meaningful federal gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years
* Taking aggressive action to combat the climate crisis, including investing in clean energy and lowering energy costs for families

**And that’s just scratching the surface.** [Will you join our team in thanking President Biden for his decades of public service and dedication to the American people? Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, friend?
While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country.**** And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
For months, polls have shown me neck and neck with my extreme GOP opponent in Nevada's must-win Senate race. Now, with less than four months to go until the election,** _The Cook Political Report_ named Nevada “the most PERILOUS" battleground for Democrats.**
**So please, I have to urgently ask:**[**If the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you****– if you're with me in the fight to continue making progress for the people and communities that we love –****will****you chip in $5 or more today to help me defend my seat in Nevada and our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89756579/488354503/1399925512?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4251-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZGE1MTcwMS00ODRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o9UBMVNeULcN6p0KN3sScHS2d3Fv2HjOkwG9VDgsgpA=)

Friend,

This World Conservation Day, I'm reminded of why I decided to run for Senate in the first place.

**In the face of man-made climate change and politicians like Rick Scott who willfully turn a blind eye as their policies destroy the natural beauty that made me fall in love with the Sunshine State in the first place — I had to make saving that beauty a key priority of my work in Congress.**
See, Florida is home to more than 80 distinct ecosystems — and in Congress, I worked tirelessly on the Subcommittee on Water Resources and Environment to bolster the natural resilience of the delicate Everglades, wetlands, and coastlines in my district from careless, profit-driven over-development.
I fought to fortify our world-class beaches and clear blue waters, safeguard the stunning coral reefs extending along the Keys (the only living barrier reef in the continental United States), and conserve the countless precious species that make Florida one of the most biodiverse states in the country.
Thanks to that work, I earned the endorsement of the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund almost as soon as I announced my candidacy for Senate.

But whether or not Republicans like Rick Scott believe in climate change _ _ —**its effects on our homes, our economy, and our future are undeniable.**
Our Sunshine State is on the front lines of a veritable climate crisis. We've long felt the deadly impacts of stronger storms, hotter summers, and higher seas.
**And due to our heightened vulnerability, working families now bear the brunt of extreme property insurance premiums while their taxes are spent rebuilding in the wake of the billion-dollar natural disasters we withstand each year — ****instead of going toward the cost-saving solutions that will prevent them.**
But as governor, my opponent banned the use of the term “climate change” and still dismisses it as "nuisance flooding" — **a convenient way to gloss over the fact that his policies were directly responsible for the devastating impacts of those floods on our communities.**
"Red Tide Rick" rolled back the critical environmental protections that could've prevented the toxic algae blooms that led to massive marine animal die-offs and the poisoning of our seafood. His obsession with short-term profit has led to the destruction of not only Florida's beauty, but also the robust industries and communities that depend on it to thrive.
In short, he's left our state's future on the line. **So this World Conservation Day, I'm counting on you to join me in the fight for Florida and for every community and creature that calls the Sunshine State home.**

body:
There's a U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _"Manhood."_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter:
**[Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by chipping in $10 or more today? With so much at stake in this election — and with a race this close — no one can afford to sit on the sidelines.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)
---
Lucas won’t be another shady, corrupt politician. He’s put his money where his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives.
**He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office.**
Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley. He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country, by banning insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to real, everyday Missourians.
I can’t tell you how excited I am about everything we’ll be able to accomplish in Missouri with Lucas fighting for us in the Senate, Peter. But if we’re going to take advantage of this historic opportunity, Lucas urgently needs your help.
**[So please, will you chip in $10 right now so we can get Lucas’ unifying message in front of voters, defeat Josh Hawley, and flip Missouri’s Senate seat this year? Lucas is running a truly grassroots campaign, so anything you’re able to give really does make a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61612?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)
---
Thanks for hearing me out,
Jon Hamm
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61611?refcode=em20240728-7201&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=7201%2E614464%2EPEbRNY)

name: Michael Baumgartner
subject: Less than 10 days!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vote Baumgartner for Congress | (509) 370-8398 | www
body:
How you can help | | | | | |
---
| **Less than 10 days!**
---
| The Primary election is only **ten** days away.
We need all hands on deck for the final stretch!
My Democratic opponent Carmela Conroy is strongly supported by Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown and the left-wing machine. They know that with an open seat and control of Congress at stake, Eastern Washington’s race for Congress will be a battle ground that will impact the entire country.
We need to keep raising money to stay on TV and radio, and to keep contacting voters. Please donate if you can: $100, $50, $25 - even $5 pays for a yard sign.
Thank you!
---
[DONATE TODAY!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=90b27393ef&e=5a45b9550e)
|
---
| **Reception tomorrow in Walla Walla**
---
| For those in the Walla Walla area, we would love to see you at our fundraising reception **tomorrow on Monday, July 29** \- graciously hosted by Hon. Mike and Cory Hewitt, Paul and Gail Mackay, Ben and Sharon Sinner and Justin Wylie.
Details are below, and you can also RSVP [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=d129a71a5f&e=5a45b9550e).
---
[](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=a2ee9de4d7&e=5a45b9550e)
|
---
| **Parading in Davenport**
---
| We had great fun last weekend at Davenport Pioneer Days! All the children were with us (a rare weekend without sports or scout camps!) - along with fantastic volunteers. Thank you for all the smiles and the high fives!
---
| **Sign-waving!**
---
| We’ve had volunteers out waving signs in Spokane every weekday. Our wonderful supporters Michael and Mary Nguyen even painted a home-made flag to support the campaign. Thank you!
---
|
# Deer Park, Spokane Valley and more
---
| Also this week - thanks to Modern Electric for hosting me at “State of the City” in Spokane Valley.
I enjoyed speaking at the Grand Opening of New World Nail & Spa in Spokane Valley. It’s important to support our small businesses!
Yesterday we had a great time at Deer Park Settlers Day, meeting folks at the parade.
This morning I was honored to meet members of the Slavic community at the Pilgrim Baptist Church. It’s wonderful to see how this community celebrates faith, family and hard work.
Throughout this week I’ve been out with our campaign team knocking on doors and making calls to voters.
---
| **More great letters**
---
| Thank you to our great letter writers! We really appreciate the support.
**Spokesman: Let voters decide** I’m writing in response to the letter (“Conroy best choice for Congress,” July 14) that focused on congressional candidate Michael Baumgartner’s support for the initiatives that will be on our ballots this November.His Democrat opponent, Carmela Conroy, is simply wrong to oppose these initiatives.Initiative 2117 repeals the unnecessary “cap-and-invest” law that added an estimated 43 cents to the cost of a gallon of gas last year, hurting families, businesses and our farmers.Initiative 2109 rolls back the state capital gains tax – which is effectively an income tax, and therefore illegal under the Washington State Constitution. Washington voters have rejected an income tax 10 times!Initiative 2124 would end the long-term care insurance program, which is a badly designed program that many of us have been compelled to pay into – instead of being allowed to make our own decisions on long -term care options.These are great, common-sense initiatives that will make Washington state a better place to live.I am very grateful to Michael Baumgartner for his vocal support of these initiatives, and to his political supporter Brian Heywood of Let’s Go Washington for helping collect the thousands of signatures needed to get these measures on our ballot – so that the voters can decide._Susan Bacon, Spokane_[ Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=8d7c626aae&e=5a45b9550e)
**Spokesman: Baumgartner to replace CMR** We have an impressive list of people hoping to represent us after the retirement of Cathy McMorris-Rodgers. My experience working for state Sen. Michael Baumgartner makes my choice easy even with such a strong field of candidates. Mike has the experience, character and intelligence to represent us well in our nation’s capital. His work in Olympia and as our county treasurer speaks for itself. But what impresses me most about Mike is his devotion to his family. Please join me in supporting Mike as he will work hard to secure our border, reduce crime and hopefully restore fiscal sanity in this great republic._Matt McCoy, Spokane_[ Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=1b12891ec2&e=5a45b9550e)
**Moscow-Pullman Daily News: Backs Baumgartner** When we moved to the Palouse in 1979, we bought a home in Colton. While we wouldn’t meet Michael Baumgartner for another 30 years, we did get to know his mom, Dee, a kindergarten teacher whose love and encouragement for her students, including our daughters, seemed to bubble up from a bottomless well of goodwill.Fast-forward to 2009: Our daughters are leading a local effort to send cards and small tokens of appreciation to American servicemen deployed to Middle East; Dee’s son, Michael, now working for the U.S. State Department with Ambassador Ryan Crocker in Baghdad, agrees to speak to a group of residents at Whitman Senior Living Community about his experiences and the impact their efforts have on troop morale. We attended that gathering. Michael impressed us deeply.Today, 15 years later, Michael Baumgartner — former officer of the State Department in Iraq and counter-narcotics adviser in Afghanistan, former Washington state senator (two terms), and current Spokane County treasurer — has offered to put his extensive experience, education and expertise to work for us, his neighbors and fellow citizens of eastern Washington, as our representative in the U.S. Congress. Someone as uniquely qualified and honorably motivated to serve deserves a chance. Please join us in supporting Michael with your vote. Thank you._Rod and Paula Schwartz, Pullman_[ Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=4d6b1fb0e9&e=5a45b9550e)
**Spokesman: Baumgartner doesn’t exaggerate his claims** Michael Baumgartner claimed in his new TV ad that he helped fully fund the North-South freeway and brought a new medical school for Washington State University.Some doubted what was expressed by Baumgartner, with a viewer even requesting that journalists fact check these claims. This resulted in KXLY recently running a segment to find out if such claims were true. After extensive research into his tenure within the state Senate, they verified the authenticity of such claims. Baumgartner, with the help of others in his effort, truly did help bring results for Eastern Washington. Not only that, he doesn’t exaggerate his claims, nor is he dishonest about his accomplishments. He simply tells it as it is, and that’s why I like Baumgartner. He’ll deliver the kind of results, through working together and determination, in Congress._Tom Barnhart, Spokane_[ Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=ef3142aaa2&e=5a45b9550e)
If you are interested in writing a letter to help our campaign and would like to know how to get it submitted, please contact eleanor@votebaumgartner.com.
---
|
# Volunteering
---
| Please be in touch if you can wave signs with us this week in Spokane.
You can also:
* Knock on doors in your neighborhood (we can provide addresses!)
* Call voters to encourage them to vote for us (we can provide lists!)
* Host a yard sign - reply to this email, or fill out the “Get Involved” form on our website [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=f091cec4e5&e=5a45b9550e).

---
|
---
| **Thank you!**
---
| In these final days before the Primary election, I want to say how much our family has appreciated the wonderful support and practical help over these past months. We have been blessed by your encouragement, amazing friendship and of course the generous financial support of so many people.
We’re working as hard as we can and hope we will make you proud.
Best-Mike
---
|
---
[DONATE TODAY!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=82786471e0&e=5a45b9550e)
|

# Support of Women
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter,
There are 11 women and one man competing in the Paris Olympics who have connections to Nevada. We congratulate and support each of them. If Dina Titus had her way, many of these women might not be there. Here is a list of our wonderful athletes: * Faith Dillon - Women's Taekwondo * Katie Grimes - Women's Swimming * Claire Weinstein - Women's Swimming * Alexis Lagan \- Pistol Shooting * Beiwen Zhang - Women's Badminton * Luke Hobson - Men's Swimming * Perris Benegas - Women's Cycling * Stephanie Rovetti - Women's Rugby * A'ja Wilson - Women's Basketball * Chelsea Gray - Women's Basketball * Kelsey Plum - Women's Basketball * Jackie Young - Women's Basketball Each of these athletes worked hard for years to make it to the Olympics. However, some of the women might not have had this opportunity. Titus supports allowing biological males to compete in women's sports. This would result in men taking opportunities away from women. Even worse, she supports biological males showering with girls and women, and using the same bathroom facilities. This is not how to support women! Women's sports, showers, and restroom facilities should be for biological women. Period. Hard stop! The person I am today is a result of the men and women in my life. I love and respect the women who have influenced me. Here is a partial list: My wife, Lesly, chose to be a stay-at-home mom to raise our four children. She taught preschool in our home to hundreds of young children. From her, I've learned patience and charity. My mom, Patricia, served in the Navy and taught nursing at UNLV and CSN. From her, I learned the importance of serving others and our country. My female bosses in my military and civilian career taught me how to be an effective leader by showing respect for others. My daughter and daughters-in-law each have advanced college degrees and important careers in healthcare and education. They juggle competing demands while raising my grandchildren as equal partners with their husbands. From them, I've learned to respect the rising generation. As your representative in Congress, I will fight to protect the rights, opportunities, and safety of women and girls. This includes sports, healthcare, education, military service, and employment. Let's send a message to Titus that it is time for her to retire as she no longer represents the people of her district.
*******

Dear Fellow Patriot,I’m reaching out to you with a plea for help—Former Atlanta Police Officer James Burn faces life in prison for doing his job, _and he desperately needs your help today._ James’ entire prosecution has been a witch hunt. This good American cop did nothing wrong. But, the radical left prosecutor in charge of James’ case is on a mission to ruin James’ life in exchange for political capital.I’m sure you’ve heard of liberal prosecutors attacking conservatives and hard working Americans they disagree with by abusing the legal system as a tool for their Anti-American schemes. . . Well, that’s exactly what’s going on here._**Let me quickly give you the facts:**_
---
* On June 23, 2016, James responded to a call about a suspect breaking into a parked vehicle.
* James arrived on scene and watched a person matching the suspect’s description enter a vehicle. So, James did what any police officer would do – he put on his emergency lights.
* Well, the suspect immediately spooked and drove the vehicle he was breaking into directly at James’s police car. _This was a life-threatening attack on James, a police officer, which is a crime in and of itself!_
* Fearing for his life and hoping not to be struck by the suspect’s car, James tried to stop it by discharging his weapon one time.

---
James struck the violent suspect and killed him. Now I’ve got to say, it’s a tragedy that a life was lost, but James was just doing his job – he was protecting his community from a thief and protecting his own life from being taken by a vehicle charging towards him.But soon after the incident, the Fulton County, Georgia District Attorney charged James with _murder_. . . and is trying to put him away for life. . . when all James was trying to do was protect his life and his community.Now, after 8 long years of a messy legal battle and James losing everything he has, James is finally scheduled to go to trial this fall. But, sadly the current District Attorney who is trying to put James behind bars is none other than . . . Fani Willis . . . Yes, **_that_** _Fani Willis_ – the same prosecutor who brought election interference charges against President Donald Trump.It won’t shock you to learn that Fani Willis is as anti-cop and progressive as prosecutors come. Crews are [making progress containing the California wildfire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHyoyAQgPGnwQ4HViJYUFxjl2uvdFZZIglGB9Y4efubu_pff803vz_36Y4pp_fjN27kOe4TLpw-NFkJgwQzmSb4SATUNeS1BYBe3ZxpVn_rZtTDoqwbBjAxdMPN6RgCaIwzRN0kDwqMsjBopbR2LUIXLVLQ8xyhh14YRSHxXtrnnt68Uszf_UOlXfatyX5lPqrofgkYBYzXdbWvpeC_KGDEwmnJJGA8sLxkTIXk88xfCU6eR0CmKueTmSTTihvKumJllEc-N6xy2c83J6oCxl5b7ZyyTfHhuFLOqfZWGPXYMOX_K_wzzMfD3wAAAP__UrJmMA) that became the largest active blaze in the U.S. over the weekend and the seventh largest in state history, ravaging over 350,000 acres. Cooler temperatures and increased humidity assisted thousands of firefighters in [slowing the wildfire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uMyEQAJ_mrsOC5e8oKL7Gnb825WkPFnsjfFgcsZW3j5w65WiKkebjsl6QK-_X_3inOEpbMQ1-0uoFBAFmNXOOhQhIzxSVBwAn7WLmWzRKWeN1Ir1sNiEi5c1bQAw-o_Nq5ggSjPQQlJRKLScEXTxSVttWwIGbjKTMo_XTZ-N93KjU7_akfkrtPtd4G-NxTPrfBOcJzvjY6XW81Rv64FRpgvPXIV5cc-FOh0hYubS-M4rW6dp2YUqRZNWivVIBNaS0SEslGRecT8HMPebHi2vlw_nJyOsduf72x983nhF-AgAA___HaGDt), which is one of several currently spreading in the western U.S. and Canada. The blaze, dubbed the Park Fire, began on Wednesday when a now-imprisoned man [pushed a burning car](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfgzcsOBNjDwyf9MlbulRVR-swh3MVMRGgpOmvr9q587u8et7P6xk58bG_4JVci3nFrfGdVithlmBW0wUXiYCGjpy2ADCq02S6i_M2Wq-MhWkeJz3NYbY6olLzhH48TdCxAwVGWZi1UlpPPcIQLVLQ3kcYYRRGUeCWS_-R-WgXiumZ71T6LV-75C6t3aoY_glYBCzot4Metd_zTxawvL0KWDZMHHM5GOWDU4hcSNLnLeVAVZqTUkriVqjKXGjPh_QJv0gmLDvVJmCpLZenGBYOYvivNcA4DGC74sLtwSlxHa0war8ip9-r9rfR3cF3AAAA___DRWfm) into a gully in Chico, California.

CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom Named to NRCC's Young Guns List

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom was named in the
first wave of the National Republican Congressional Committee's Young
Guns Program.

In the announcement, NRCC Chairman Richard Hudson said, "Extreme House
Democrats' border, crime and cost of living crises wrecked Americans'
safety and security. Fortunately, these Republican candidates are
already well on their way to running winning campaigns that will grow
our House majority in November."

Following this announcement, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom stated, "It's
time to get our country back on track, which is why I am honored to be
named to NRCC's Young Guns Program in my race to defeat liberal Mary
Peltola. I have a proven record of fighting for Alaskans and winning,
and that's exactly what I will do when I get to Washington, DC. Peltola
has voted in lockstep with the Biden-Harris administration's
anti-Alaska agenda. This November, we have an opportunity to vote for
change."

Young Guns is the NRCC's program to boost House candidates in
competitive general election races. Click here to read the full press
release from the NRCC.

I'm ready to defeat Ted Cruz this November and fight to build a more perfect union for my boys and every kid in Texas. But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign. To win, I need a massive movement of grassroots supporters to step up and join me in this fight. | | | I'm so grateful to have you fighting with me. – Colin | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Cliff Schecter President, Blue Amp Action Amplify Good ---|--- | | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. ## CenterPoint Apologizes For Beryl Response
CenterPoint Energy executives [apologized to customers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFy6yAQAL8GdXjgBJIoKF6jzq9NqUHiZN8E6xhgLCdfn3H61Nvs7sd1uQZKdNz-hwf69tp5CVujJy6jBCfBLKaLflXR6Q69HgHA2hF0d_cQLUDvUA8uTKtWMUY9KGfGqOO0WtuRBwVGjeC0skPvLrAZgF3BZKZ1R6uEURipcbm0OzZ8hbqnL35iuWz86JK_t5ar6P8JmAXMYd10_yYC5sy1CZg3PBqWzHQ0GTInvtE3Vpn5xCK3QpWqzIUzV6zy3cWHzCkc8uTyKWDWVjnjlBEwd8XHfFJKVIdRGHV7BEq_Hu2PLU8PPwEAAP__I2NlBA) during a Thursday meeting of the Public Utility Commission for their lackluster response to Hurricane Beryl earlier this month, promising to improve preparation, communication, and cooperation with local agencies. The company said it's [investing](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OozAURp_GdEbmYv4KFxut6LJbTokccw1XMjZjmxDefpT0036fdHR0vu7TXZMjv_zTG6r8smHSJtMTp47DwEFOspjVQ8xDVaCqOgBomg6qYlWmbUXda9QAdd8P0loDHXS6rweYrREFKRAgRQdDJZq2HkowEsAK6GX_sNgIJgXOlEMs84oZXzpZd4UnxtKErXBqzXlPrP7DYGQwnudZbsm_PwYjen4kBuMWPF4MRhO2XXvC9_ZB8SOTo3zxiMvhdA4x8SWSc9ygzxj3QD5z9BiXiwfP1yNGMtojf2C8HI-Y9uATMhh15Ldb9f3X_N-LqOb9JOcotR2TYtk0uY9u_qXeU8FPAAAA___zqnVz) in vegetation management, mobile generators, and replacing 1,000 wooden poles with composite ones. They also plan to roll out a new, neighborhood-level outage tracker. The PUC will [offer an online survey](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGTnDAMRn-N6bRjhIGjcJGG7tKm3DFGLJp4LcbWLnf_PkMmbbpXvJknfb8-75-BE-fHz_Akr1-b3ENUftN9BJwA3d01q1_sOrUN-XZExL4fsW12PzhH7dZP3WCXgBSHtXNhWHq3hnbcutiwR4vOjji1th-66YbRIW4WP9zHslFvjbO0skq56U5KX6Fu6VveVG5Rnk3yu-pRTffD4GxwPs_zFhPH37jLq6rkyzI4ZzqrwTlJDMngfDUNzna8eDA4_7MhFAoQL35SqXBySvAgBRV4C0cCOTiz5AqSIVJWKodw1gqF6iG50qXuXFUKR5CXhgdVCJtSgf1VCseQCRYq39cdTfHrcUW4DqNx9vEMnP4-pv_Z-e3xTwAAAP__z4GDxA) for CenterPoint customers and local governments to get feedback on the company's performance during the hurricane.

name: Greater Georgia
subject: GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES SIX-FIGURE CAMPAIGN TO MOBILIZE DIVERSE COMMUNITIES
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, JULY 29
GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES SIX-FIGURE CAMPAIGN TO MOBILIZE DIVERSE COMMUNITIES
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia announced its latest campaign to mobilize a diverse range of voters ahead of the 2024 election. The organization will use a combination of digital ads, text messages, phone calls, and direct mail to reach a targeted universe of Black, Hispanic, and Asian voters in key counties across Georgia. The six-figure campaign will highlight how the liberal policies in Washington have failed Georgians on the economy, crime, immigration, foreign policy, and other kitchen-table issues.
"For too long, liberals have taken the minority community for granted - banking on their votes each election year but consistently failing to make their lives better," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "With the progressive wing now in charge, every citizen is faced with high inflation, open borders, rampant crime, and woke education, which negatively impacts minority communities, just as it does all Americans. This election represents an alternative: to return to the proven policies of prosperity and strength from the top of the ticket on down.
"The prospect of an even more progressive agenda would limit freedom and opportunity for those who are not part of the liberal elite, but whose votes are required to keep the liberal powerbrokers in power. We intend to show voters that there is another, better path forward to benefit every American citizen."
Greater Georgia's latest mobilization campaign builds on previous minority outreach efforts - including a recent [digital ad](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zU6z6ZdEMVzdZ15u4gMFpCQJUs5i-n5BKrJuBi6D7jh6Yrk7KavDuJxO_Ym5TDf5n-4cvyX0VdFChu23gSYYB4uDpvlORAiQwn8TghfYlq5_mvJG3YxFoPpo0be31D6Z2oDb4BSFxYQlFTcX_zrC4UEf4cq1b670c_oU4y68BL9XZvIw8YggnRA0pIfoKKn2DSK0ZXNZ_2UCA0DSCHa3pYcWWCPcsgMbwPzmLrK9z9I2QM1VFIzfqP3nVEznM3gDXMNkYaHf-Cc=&c=UfBg-kMlxeI9bbN50er4jlW-vDO9GNhrnXRIg8Imd_gGLXRykxkA5A==&ch=VNaMOTFkOMRvOMUs9Nay8bmAhAEioiE1R2JNkObO1gRgskG19w-JsA==) that aired during the June 27th presidential debate. The ad targeted 63,000 Black men in the Atlanta area and earned over a quarter-million impressions, highlighting how the Biden/Harris agenda has failed their communities.
---
| Greater Georgia, launched by former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler in 2021, is a 501(c4) nonpartisan nonprofit dedicated to growing participation in the democratic process by mobilizing and empowering voters. The group works year-round to educate and register voters, engage with diverse and underrepresented communities, and protect election integrity. ###

I have been traveling the country and campaigning for Democrats -- at their request -- in swing states and races everywhere. That work will continue, but it takes resources.
We are also building the largest volunteer operation in the country. Yes, you read that right. As you read this, we have thousands of volunteers texting Democrats across the country asking them to volunteer. This powerful new lawsuit will rein in the FBI, too.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with my critically important new case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

If we win, that means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.

Let me tell you, these lawsuits are very expensive and time consuming.

But Zach and his fellow January patriots and their families are worth it.

**[Patriot, PLEASE help me GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zu23s82jrbj30qtelq5dofu72brmlbe61vgo0s38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c9jm8pb6cph2bs)**

You and I can make a huge difference for suffering patriots if we take these lawsuits all the way.

Larry Klayman

body:
How a candidate funds their campaign does more than just influence how they pay for staff, ads, and organizing. It has a direct impact on both our message and who we actually serve in office.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
This email is longer than usual, but I promise what you read here won’t be like anything else you see from anyone else emailing you today. **So before I ask you to[chip in your first donation before our critical end-of-month deadline this week,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61615?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG) will you please give me a moment to explain?**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61615?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG)**
How a candidate funds their campaign does more than just influence how they pay for staff, ads, and organizing. It has a direct impact on both our message and who we actually serve in office. **Any politician or pundit who tells you otherwise is lying — and I have the receipts.**
Despite virtually every member of Congress having campaigned on making life-saving drugs more accessible, politicians who take millions of dollars from Big Pharma are still telling us we have to accept a world where people die because they have to ration their medicine.
Then we have out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley, who have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own them — and they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more liars or frauds like Josh Hawley in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why I'm asking you to add a donation of whatever you can toward our people-powered campaign before our next major end-of-month fundraising deadline on this Wednesday, July 31. Can I count on you to help us take this seat back for working people, Peter?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61615?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61616?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61616?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61615?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG)
---
Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access — **I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money — **I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I want you to be part of it:**
**[So if you’re ready to help us defeat Josh Hawley and give Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat back to everyday people, please add a donation of whatever you can before our end-of-month deadline later this week.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/61615?refcode=em20240729-7202&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7202%2E614464%2E_5kXFG)**

Karen

## **IMPORTANT EPIC Legislation Hearing
_Wednesday, July 31st_!**
#### **State Capitol
Location: Room 1524
Time: 9:30 AM**
---
| **The NEGOP State Central Committee (governing body) voted in 2022 and 2023 to endorse the EPIC Tax Reform plan. The petition failure was not the outcome we would have liked and many across this state, who are seeking, almost begging, for income and property tax relief. We know unprecedented tax reform is needed to keep farms, ranches, and homes with their rightful owners.** _**WHAT NEBRASKANS ARE SAYING ABOUT TAXES**_
_**Following are personal comments from Nebraskans who participated in a NEGOP survey about taxes. Once you read their experiences, please consider attending the EPIC Option hearing on Wednesday.**_
* **“Assessed value on one property went from $40,000 to $200,000 in one year. Payment for taxes and insurance cost more per month than my mortgage payment was! So...I guess if I can't pay, the county will foreclose...”**
* **“We will have to move out of state due to extreme property valuations. Our valuation went up $100,000 . Our neighbor's house, 10 feet from our house, is valued at $296,000 for the same square feet, and ours is valued at $427,000. Please explain how that is not extreme.”**
* **“At the office where I work, the valuation in 2024 has gone up $300k. That is $900 more a month for our loan. We cannot afford another increase at all! I’m still trying to figure out how we can even pay for the extra $900 a month! I work for a private family business and we do not want to sell to a corporation, but the way Nebraska punishes small businesses we will have no choice in the future if things don’t change. There will be zero family businesses left!”**

**The EPIC Option bills—LB 16 (implementation), LR4CA (consumption tax on new goods, excluding groceries), and LR5CA (elimination of existing 5 taxes)—are scheduled for a crucial hearing. We need your presence and voice to advocate for these transformative changes!** **Here’s how you can help:**
1. **Show Up: Attend the hearing to demonstrate strong community support for the EPIC Option. Your presence makes a difference!**
2. **Testify: Share your personal story about how our current tax system is affecting you. If you wish to testify, prepare a brief statement (3 minutes max) about how high Nebraska taxes impact you and why you support the EPIC Option. You may also submit written testimonies at[www.nebraskalegislature.gov](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=c348ba868d&e=25844e23a8).**

**Spread the Word: Inform your family, friends, and neighbors about this important hearing. Encourage them to join us in supporting the EPIC Option.**

_Todd Watson
Political Director_

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi! I’m Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
This is me with my cats, Ada (named after computer science pioneer Ada Lovelace) and Nikola (named after inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla).
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Contrary to what JD Vance thinks, I’m actually not miserable! Nor do I think I deserve less of a voice in our democracy than any other American — unlike Vance.
(Seriously — JD Vance has said in multiple recently resurfaced interviews that he thinks the Democratic Party is being run by “miserable childless cat ladies” and that people without kids have less of a stake in our country and should have less of a voice. Oh, and he thinks we should pay more taxes. Like, what?)
At first glance, those comments are so absurd that they’re funny.
But the thing is, he’s not joking .
And when someone who’s in the running to be our nation’s next Vice President says stuff like this, we have to listen to what he’s really saying. Here’s my best attempt at a translation:
Women have to be married and have kids to be happy and functioning members of our society. We should define who gets to vote based on their parental status. Cats are bad (??!!).
Meanwhile, he’s also trying to take control of how people become parents in the first place, with positions that threaten to limit both IVF and birth control, not to mention other reproductive care.
If you’ve read this far and you agree that we can’t let JD Vance anywhere near the Vice Presidency, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign here in Virginia. We’re working around the clock to make sure VA’s 13 electoral votes go to Kamala Harris, not the Trump-Vance ticket — and that we can re-elect Tim Kaine to the U.S. Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Look, everyone is entitled to their own views. You don’t like cats? Fine! But what you don’t get to do — especially when you’re in the running to lead this country! — is tell the American people that their personal reproductive choices make them less a part of our democracy. That’s just BS.

Team,
I know things have been chaotic over the last several weeks. To be honest with you, I’ve been having a hard time keeping up. Between my work in Congress, the campaign, and two young kids at home... well, sometimes it feels like there isn’t enough time in a day to stay on top of everything.
But I want to zero you in on something incredibly important right now. Something that isn’t going to go away in a day or two. Our primary election is tomorrow. That’s important, because we need to show that our campaign has what it takes to go the distance between now and then. But it’s important for another reason, too.
After tomorrow, it looks like Kari Lake will be my opponent. We’ll see how things shake out in their primary, but all signs point to her.
And team, Kari Lake is just about the last person on earth we’d want to have in the U.S. Senate. Put aside the majority that we’re fighting for, the priorities we need to keep working on, everything else. Kari Lake is Trump’s biggest cheerleader, bar none. She undermines our elections. She pals around with Q Anon conspiracy theorists and people like Marjorie Taylor Greene, Steve Bannon.
She’s dangerous. Period. I’m going to do everything I can to turn out our voters and defeat her, but if we don’t raise what we need, she will be the next U.S. Senator from Arizona.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
IR’s Vargas, Kaspar, Testify Before State Election Board in Case Brought by IL GOP Ally, to Silence, Intimidate Publication (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
By Illinois Review
IR’s Editor-in-Chief Mark Vargas and General Counsel Scott Kaspar were compelled to testify for a second time last Friday before the Illinois State Board of Elections related to a frivolous case that has spanned nearly a year meant to intimidate the owners of the state’s largest conservative, America First news publication.

The alleged crime? Exposing the misdeeds of IL GOP elitists and allies of former IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy.

On August 1, 2023, Illinois Review
broke news (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/mayor-keith-pekau-was-running-federal-congressional-campaign-raising-money-from-city-contractors-from-taxpayer-funded-village-hall-foia-requests-reveal.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that Orland Park mayor Keith Pekau and his village trustees were using taxpayer-funded village resources to run his failed congressional campaign against incumbent U.S. Rep. Sean Casten (D-IL). Days after, William Healy, an Orland Park village trustee, filed a complaint against Illinois Review’s General Counsel, Scott Kaspar. Healy, a CPA, remains under investigation (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2022/10/12/column-complaint-accuses-orland-park-mayor-keith-pekau-of-using-mayoral-campaign-funds-for-congressional-bid/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) by the Federal Election Commission for allegedly comingling state and federal campaign contributions relating to Mayor Pekau’s failed congressional bid.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
IR’s Mark Vargas testifies before the Illinois State Board of Election on Friday, July 26, 2024. (Illinois Review)
At a preliminary hearing last October, the Illinois State Board of Elections hearing officer found that Kaspar and Vargas had done no wrong, finding that Illinois Review was an independent and long-standing news organization not under the purview of the Board’s election authority.

Despite the hearing officer’s decision, allies of senior IL GOP leaders ignored the report that found no wrongdoing, and instead, requested that the case go to the next round regardless of the preliminary ruling. And on Friday, almost a year later, Vargas and Kaspar testified for a second time.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
IR’s Scott Kaspar testifies before the Illinois State Board of Election on Friday, July 26, 2024. (Illinois Review)
Lawfare has been a powerful tool of the establishment to maintain control by burying opposition with legal fees, time-consuming discovery, and a myriad of never-ending legal proceedings.

There is no lawfare more famous and pervasive than the lawsuits launched by Biden Administration allies in the Department of Justice and the state of New York against former President Donald Trump, now the Republican presidential nominee for president.

Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-IL) recently admitted (https://x.com/EndWokeness/status/1793267044315783672?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) the impact lawfare has had on Trump, stating, “He’s got court and the man practically has the legal version of ‘ankle bracelet’ around him and he can’t leave the Five Boroughs because he always has to be in court.”

Trump often has
remarked (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-deliver-fiery-post-indictment-speech-georgia-rcna88561?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that he is the recipient of lawfare because he fights to protect the liberties and freedoms of the American people. “In the end, they’re not coming after me. They’re coming after you – and I’m just standing in their way.”

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/irs-vargas-kaspar-testify-before-state-election-board-in-case-brought-by-il-gop-ally-to-silence-intimidate-publication.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e220e57422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former President Donald Trump sits in Manhattan criminal court on April 23. (Pool photo by Timothy A. Clary)
And so is the case with Illinois Review, as this publication continues the work to expose the corrupt reasons why Illinois conservatives consistently lose.

# Erin Farris-Olsen for Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court 2024,

I don’t think it’s controversial to say that the people of Montana deserve a justice system that works for them - a system comprised of people who can maintain impartiality and give us a fair shake when we come to seek justice for ourselves and our communities.
To cut to the chase, [**I’m running for us to be the Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court, and I need your help to win.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=6c61222be3&e=5e62e9066d)
**Clerks of the court are the first line of support for Montanans seeking justice.**

---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=59e3117bf7&e=5e62e9066d)
| As an attorney, I have worked for the Montana Supreme Court, and have collaborated with judges, clerks, courts, attorneys, and legal associations across the state improving court efficiencies that also serve people.
**We have the chance to ensure that every Montanan gets a fair shake, with a Clerk who can maintain impartiality and objectivity, and protect the integrity of the Judiciary for all Montanans.**
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=c7005e8fb1&e=5e62e9066d)
| To make that our reality, I just need your help. **You opened this email because it asked if you were looking for a job, and there’s no more important job than preserving the integrity of the judiciary in the state we call home.**
Campaigning is expensive, and without people like you to support our race, we can’t run the race we need to run to win. [**Your donation, even if only $10, $25, or $50, will make a difference in the lives of hundreds of thousands of people.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=bb1824a5e3&e=5e62e9066d)
Regards,
**Erin**

| | | The extremist Supreme Court majority is out of control, and no longer even pretending to follow the law or Constitution. They’ve handed down a host of awful opinions that have chipped away at our rights and put our democracy in jeopardy. With three of these justices appointed by Trump, it’s no surprise they’ve been handing him win after win – including immunity from prosecution for “official acts.” And because they serve for life, we'll have to suffer from their corruption and biases for decades after they were appointed. [That’s why President Biden and other top Democrats are calling for major reforms to the Supreme Court, including term limits. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta5e4df05-1914-4327-b1ad-51a6492c6b39/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Supreme Court justices shouldn’t be able to hold lifelong positions, and rule as kings, ignoring the will of the people. We need Congress to make this process more democratic and impose term limits that help ensure justices and their decisions reflect what is just, and what is right. [Add your name to demand term limits for Supreme Court justices >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td0278eb6-cc6f-49e1-8696-ef56ebb5b0d4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: Protect the Indian River Lagoon
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE HARIDOPOLOS FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | | Dear friend,
I have called Brevard County home since 1989, raising my family along the beautiful Lagoon. That's why it's so important for us to come together to care for our environment.
Our quality of life, economy, tourism, property values, and the survival of many indigenous species of plants and wildlife depend on our efforts. Advancing common-sense ideas that protect our Lagoon and preserve our natural beauty is crucial to me.
The National Estuary Program (NEP) was created by Congress in 1987 to protect and restore the water quality and ecological integrity of estuaries of national significance.
In Congress, I will vote to sustain the NEP program to help maintain our nation’s environmental treasures like the Indian River Lagoon. Additionally, I will join the bipartisan Congressional Estuary Caucus, created by Bill Posey, to help address the growing challenges faced by our 28 estuaries across the nation.

| Dear Peter,
---
| I am incredibly proud of being an American. On August 2, 1984, I was sworn in as a U.S. Citizen and I want to invite you to celebrate my 40th anniversary with me this Friday in South San Francisco’s Buri Buri Park. Bring a lawn chair or blanket, your whole family, and make yourself comfortable as we indulge in hot dogs and share camaraderie with fellow Americans and immigrants alike. We hope to have a huge crowd so bring a side dish or dessert to share if you want to make sure the food doesn’t run out.
I look forward to sharing my personal journey from being an immigrant to attaining citizenship and expressing what being an American means to me.

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary
rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osyNZGEWtN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Asked by
a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary
rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

While
studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became
convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was
essential to the good practice of law.

Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's
cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in
the six books of Euclid at sight."

By
studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly-plus,
in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.

That's
why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the
topic "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry."

Through
"Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry," you will
learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for
pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in
everyday life.

Now, the
course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in
your home or for use in a small group.

You can
receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible
gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach
efforts on behalf of liberty.

Your
tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and
other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our
nation. And your gift matters even more because...

Hillsdale
accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of
government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or
state student grants or loans.

That's
why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the
importance of education to liberty.

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve
your copy today. I've included a secure link for you to make your
tax-deductible gift below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63430421:syNZGEWtN:m:3:2627245898:D0D06EE4176C27E5639D990413F50A99:r

Thank you
for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of
liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Peter - My first rule when starting the Endex Concealed Carry line - my new campaign merchandise - was that everything MUST be MADE IN AMERICA. It would have been much simpler and cheaper from a production standpoint to make the pants, shorts, and concealed holster system overseas. But cheap means low quality fabric that maybe lasts a year before you need to trash the clothes and buy again. Endex clothes are designed to last. The flexible 4-way stretch twill fabric is durable, breathable, wrinkle proof, and water resistant. And the fit is modern and stylish – you can wear these pants anywhere, from the board room to the golf course to the zombie apocalypse. The patented Sidewinder Holster System features: ✔️ 5 holster positions for compact and sub-compact pistols ✔️ 6 magazine holsters ✔️ 2 integrated magnets for quick empty mag stowage ✔️ Ambidextrous design for right and left-handed functionality ✔️ Removable - you can wear it with any pants or shorts, not just Endex brand And best of all, when you purchase Endex, you're helping me grow the Republican majority this November. I don't make a dime from this - the profits go to funding U.S. House races across the country. name: Cori Bush
subject: re: Netanyahu.
body:
#
Peter,
Last week, war criminal and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed Congress...
By bestowing Netanyahu with a joint address, Congress is not only green-lighting genocide; it is celebrating the man at the forefront of it.
That’s why I – along with many of my colleagues – boycotted his address in protest of his ongoing genocide of Palestinians in Gaza. In the face of escalating violence and oppression, Netanyahu's policies in Gaza and the West Bank should be condemned, not welcomed.
In Congress, I advocate for those left behind by the political establishment and stand up against injustice everywhere; _**I'll never back down to bullies, would-be-dictators, or genocidaires.**_
In just over a week, I’m facing off against AIPAC and their far-right megadonors, who are spending millions to defeat me, because they know we threaten their destructive agenda. _I need you to stand with us._

# What's Happening in Venezuela
---
|
---
Last night, Dictator Maduro announced his self-proclaimed victory to the Venezuelan people. His speech was fueled by Christian nationalism, hateful rhetoric towards global leaders, and claims of victimhood. He also reintroduced his self-authored book on political strategies, which he calls the ‘7 Transformations Plan’. Maduro's broadcasting of his electoral victory falsely implied he backed a fair and free election. However, the spectacle he created was calculated, making it seem as though the overcrowded venue represented a large majority of voters. In stark contrast, the streets were filled with devastated protesters banging pots and pans, shouting “Free Venezuela” and calling for action. Maduro attacked those who campaigned for the opposition, labeling them “demons” intent on destabilizing democracy, while calling street protesters “terrorists” who threatened the nation’s safety. After 11 years in office, this latest win could mean 6 more years of human rights violations, extreme income inequality, and political violence.
---
|
---
As hateful rhetoric and corrupted nationalism rise, we must be vigilant about the dangers surrounding us. America, stand strong. Open your eyes to patterns of dictatorship: isolation, the rejection of alliances, the spread of misinformation from political leaders, and the scapegoating of minority communities. We’ve seen the worship of one political figure, the victimization of corrupt politicians, and the use of religious rhetoric in politics. We’ve witnessed enough. Trump, you will not get away with this! While we may not fully grasp the realities faced by Venezuela, we must recognize the stakes involved in the re-composition of democracy that Project 2025 seeks to implement. Stand with Venezuela. Hold the ultra-wealthy and corrupt politicians accountable. Stand for democracy.

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89802462/488463686/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240729_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjdkY2M0Yi1kMjRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BcNXNxp1rhAteNfYy0xUTf1ZVe5JuL5mIDxZQqBhZFQ=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89802463/488463687/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240729_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjdkY2M0Yi1kMjRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BcNXNxp1rhAteNfYy0xUTf1ZVe5JuL5mIDxZQqBhZFQ=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. [**Can I count on you to join our coalition today by chipping in $3 toward our $2,000 daily goal? If thousands of people like you each chip in what they can afford, I know we can take on their dark money and reclaim our House Majority. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89802464/488463688/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240729_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjdkY2M0Yi1kMjRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BcNXNxp1rhAteNfYy0xUTf1ZVe5JuL5mIDxZQqBhZFQ=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $3 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89802471/488463695/-723981995?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20240729_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjdkY2M0Yi1kMjRkLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BcNXNxp1rhAteNfYy0xUTf1ZVe5JuL5mIDxZQqBhZFQ=)

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. name: Andrew Yang
subject: 99 Days
body:
It’s going to be an action-packed 3 months. National polling has Harris and Trump within a few points of each other with Harris rising... | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=04ef21f986&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
|
---
| Hello, hope that your summer is going well.

It’s been 16 days since Donald Trump survived an assassination attempt, 14 days since JD Vance was named the Republican running mate and 8 days since Joe Biden dropped out of the presidential race. Harris’s campaign has raised $200 million in that time, a whopping amount that has lifted her to financial parity and beyond. That’s three major events in essentially the last two weeks, with some of them already feeling like a lifetime ago.

Kamala Harris will name a VP any day now leading up to the Democratic National Convention on August 19th – 22nd. At that point, there will be 75 days – about 11 weeks – until Election Day on November 5th, with many states allowing votes to be cast before then. Trump recently cast doubt on whether he will make the next Presidential Debate scheduled for September 10th against **[Kamala Harris](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=61b2e072da&e=0f227c2ae3)** , saying he wanted to make sure she was actually the nominee. Many debates don’t really impact a race, but this one definitely could. Heck, the last one caused a nominee change.

Some are proposing that Trump might swap **[JD Vance](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=16ee8ef02c&e=0f227c2ae3)** out as the press is enjoying airing out some of Vance’s more impolitic past statements. I doubt Vance gets swapped out but it would be a way to get a press cycle and select someone who might actually put more voters at ease.

It’s going to be an action-packed 3 months.

Data is coming in on how Kamala Harris polls vs. Trump – keep in mind that she’s only been at it for a week and it takes 7-10 days to get decent polling in most cases. Her approval rating is already sharply higher than it was a couple months ago by virtue of becoming the nominee. However, in some polls so is Trump’s; perhaps because of surviving an assassination attempt, Trump is closer to 50% approval in some polls than he has been in years.
---
|
---
| National polling has Harris and Trump within a few points of each other with Harris rising – but that’s not indicative of who’s going to win the Electoral College. The main question is what’s happening in the six swing states – Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Nevada and Georgia – and whether Kamala causes any other states – primarily North Carolina – to become contestable. Joe Biden’s stronghold was in the Midwestern ‘blue wall.’ He was the guy from Scranton, after all.

Can Kamala make Arizona, Nevada and/or Georgia close enough to win? And does she retain enough strength in the Midwest to close the deal in those states? It’s one reason why her choice of running mate matters, as the three reported finalists – Shapiro, Kelly and Cooper hail from PA, AZ and NC.

Given the rate of fundraising and the compressed time frame, the Harris campaign should already be ploughing its time and energy into the swing states. The money will continue to come. Figure out who can move the needle in the states that matter – including the candidate – and go door-to-door.

I’m voting for Kamala and I hope she wins. I think Trump’s a deeply flawed human who shouldn’t occupy the most powerful office in the land. Campaigns tend to be won by whichever candidate peaks at the right time. It’s certainly easy to imagine that Trump peaked too soon, while Kamala’s campaign is only getting started.

If you’re looking for local candidates to support, check out the Forward-endorsed candidates **[here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=29f9e49c9e&e=0f227c2ae3)**. We are having a reunion picnic in LA on Sunday – **[join us if you are in town](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b26c5ad3ce&e=0f227c2ae3)**!
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

President Biden has announced three key initiatives to reform the out of control U.S. Supreme Court, [tweeting and writing a Washington Post OpEd that](https://substack.com/redirect/a567ae9c-8fc2-4c3c-8f4a-8905a433b4a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> This nation was founded on a simple yet profound principle: No one is above the law. Not the President of the United States. Not a justice on the Supreme Court of the United States. So today, I'm calling for three bold reforms to restore trust and accountability to the court and our democracy.
> 1\. No more immunity for crimes a former president committed while in office
> 2\. Term limits for Supreme Court justices
> 3\. A binding code of conduct for the Supreme Court
Two things are true. One, these are much needed reforms and will move the ball forward in strengthening justice, democracy, and fairness in the United States. Two, a glance at SCOTUS history and contemporary corruption demonstrates that these reforms do not go far enough, and do not do enough to stop the influence of dangerous initiatives like the fascist Project 2025. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1354534e-f3b0-4724-9f09-6785ba29ca0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Current US Supreme Court. Credit: SCOTUS Website
