## The history of Supreme Court corruption
I've [written before on the history of SCOTUS corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/e12034df-20db-45dc-99d2-5d28d9619a74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In summary, the U.S. Supreme Court has a long history of controversial and corrupt practices. From the 19th century, the Court has often sided with powerful interests over marginalized communities. Landmark decisions like Plessy v. Ferguson (1896) upheld racial segregation under the "separate but equal" doctrine, legitimizing systemic racism. In Lochner v. New York (1905), the Court struck down labor regulations meant to protect workers, favoring business interests instead. These rulings illustrate how the Court has historically protected entrenched power structures and perpetuated social inequalities.
And it isn't just 19th or 20th century rulings. The legacy of Supreme Court decisions reveals a pattern of prioritizing corporate and political interests over justice in the 21st century. Citizens United v. FEC (2010), for instance, allowed unlimited corporate spending in elections, undermining democratic processes. This ruling intensified the influence of money in politics, skewing power further towards the wealthy. Shelby County v. Holder (2013) dismantled key provisions of the Voting Rights Act, leading to widespread voter suppression tactics, particularly against minorities. These historical and contemporary decisions highlight the Supreme Court's role in exacerbating inequality and undermining democracy.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..hB3kNJIQLYEJ4mAc4-UKh3ESq3HiP9iLe0J_YbPjOkM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147131434)
## Corruption in and out of the Courtroom
And that contemporary corruption isn't just in corrupt rulings, but in corrupt behaviors outside the courtroom with major ethical violations and conflicts of interest. For example, Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito have faced credible accusations of misconduct. Reports indicate that Justice Thomas accepted lavish gifts and failed to disclose significant financial dealings, raising questions about his impartiality. Similarly, Justice Alito has been scrutinized for his relationships with wealthy donors and involvement in cases where he had clear conflicts of interest. These ethical breaches undermine public trust in the judiciary and highlight the need for stringent ethical standards. Justice Kavanaugh faced multiple accusations of sexual abuse and harassment, yet still won confirmation.
It is no wonder that this unjust system has meant that the majority of Supreme Court justices appointed represent the vast minority of Americans. This isn't democracy, and it isn't sustainable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c2a34403-e5c6-4a36-8a77-a57a80c0db75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As a result, we suffer a judiciary that is more beholden to political interests than to principles that Americans cherish. The current Court's draconian rulings make clear that while President Biden's proposed reforms are a good start, they do not go far enough.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..hB3kNJIQLYEJ4mAc4-UKh3ESq3HiP9iLe0J_YbPjOkM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147131434)
## Contemporary unjust rulings
The current Supreme Court has issued several rulings that threaten the foundations of American democracy and civil rights. [I've written on this before](https://substack.com/redirect/206600d5-c625-474f-9da4-a89687fdefc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but as a summary some of the most grotesque rulings include:
* **Presidential Immunity:** Expanding criminal immunity for former presidents, which paves the way for unchecked executive power and dictatorship.
* **Bribery Legalization:** Overturning a bribery corruption conviction has effectively legalized bribery, eroding the democratic accountability of elected officials.
* **Criminalizing Homelessness:** Allowing the criminalization of homelessness, which ultimately pushing vulnerable people into prison systems.
* **Decriminalizing Insurrection:** Undermining laws against obstructing official proceedings, effectively decriminalizing actions like the January 6 insurrection.
* **Denying Abortion Care:** The Court's refusal to protect abortion rights exacerbates maternal mortality, especially in states with severe abortion bans.
* **Unchecked Corporate Pollution:** Stripping regulatory power from environmental agencies worsens the climate crisis and public health.

These are but a snapshot of the increasingly extreme rulings the current MAGA court continues to make. Unless we bring about additional reforms, this will only get worse. Here's what two of those critical reforms look like.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..hB3kNJIQLYEJ4mAc4-UKh3ESq3HiP9iLe0J_YbPjOkM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147131434)
## The Additional Reforms We Need
To ensure we can protect our democracy, President Biden should add at least the following two reforms to his list of Supreme Court reforms:
* **Expand the Court** : Expanding the Court aligns with historical precedent. As documented by the Supreme Court [itself](https://substack.com/redirect/b8bad691-b340-46fe-98b8-a1c1f5213900?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The number of Justices on the Supreme Court changed six times before settling at the present total of nine in 1869.
As many changes as our nation went through from March 4, 1789 (the date SCOTUS was established) to 1869 (the year of the last SCOTUS change in number of justices), it surely has gone through as many or more significant changes since then--clearly justifying further expansion. Likewise, one reason we arrived at nine justices in 1869 is our nation then had nine federal districts. Now, the United States has 13 federal districts. Precedent mandates that we remain consistent and expand to at least 13 Supreme Court seats. In other words, _not_ expanding SCOTUS to at least 13 is the actual contradiction to SCOTUS precedent.
* **Appoint an independent Judicial Council for SCOTUS** : If we accept that no person is above the law, then indeed we need an enforcement mechanism to hold Supreme Court Justices accountable. Justice Elena Kagan has an interesting idea -- [an independent judicial council made up of lower federal judges](https://substack.com/redirect/1b82621a-7fe5-4a4e-ab3c-16be16395104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is, in my view, a brilliant idea. The council would comprise of already vetted and confirmed judges, legal scholars who already know the law, and scholars who know their rulings will result in precedent potentially applicable to themselves should they be appointed to a future Supreme Court. Moreover, this council could also go through a rotation system with term limits, just as members of Congress serve on committees during their time in office.

These changes are critical to protecting our democracy and restoring the faith and trust of the American people in the Supreme Court--which is currently at historically lows.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/88c705e2-2546-4735-b4d0-ae314692db10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Conclusion
The Supreme Court's recent decisions and its history of controversial rulings represent a grave threat to democracy and human rights. Judicial reform is imperative to safeguard our democratic institutions and ensure justice for all Americans. While President Biden's proposed reforms are a step in the right direction, they do not go far enough to protect our democracy from the onslaught of fascism. While no system is perfect, we can better protect ourselves with an expanded Supreme Court to align with historical precedent and better reflect the will of the American people, and by enacting an Independent Judicial Council to actually enforce the Supreme Court code of conduct. Without these reforms, the U.S. risks further entrenchment of autocracy and systemic abuse.

Hi there, My name is Derek Tran. I’m a veteran, consumer rights advocate, city commissioner, and small business owner, and **I’m running to flip California’s 45th District – an ultra-competitive, Republican-held district here in Southern California – from red-to-blue.** **Our election has been deemed one of the _most competitive in the country_ and has the power to _determine the fate of the House Majority._** [**I’d love to tell you more about myself and why I’m in this fight, but first — if you agree we need to take back the House, will you make a $3 donation to our campaign?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89803589/488467807/-1905307898?amount=3&refcode=em_fr_2024_welcome_ntl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTFmMmI1YTctZDQ0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HiY0HO5XGNIZGJPcEQ2oHQWIyQXaaNzqdcWouaXvnuk=) **Friend, I’m the proud son of Vietnamese refugees.** Following the fall of Saigon, my parents made the brave decision to leave everything behind and start over in the United States, in hopes of giving me a better life. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89803593/488467811/-1905307898?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024_welcome_ntl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTFmMmI1YTctZDQ0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HiY0HO5XGNIZGJPcEQ2oHQWIyQXaaNzqdcWouaXvnuk=) Leaving behind their home was not easy, but **my parents were able to survive on their work ethic and their belief in the _American Dream._**__ That dream became a reality when they opened up a corner store in Southern California, where I spent my summers behind the register learning the value of hard work. America gave my parents a chance. There was no question that I’d want to give back to the country that gave so much to me. At the age of 18, I enlisted in the Army and proudly served my country.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89803596/488467815/-1905307898?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024_welcome_ntl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTFmMmI1YTctZDQ0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HiY0HO5XGNIZGJPcEQ2oHQWIyQXaaNzqdcWouaXvnuk=) **Now, I’m running for Congress to ensure that every family can realize the same American Dream that mine did all those years ago.** Extreme Republicans in Congress – especially Michelle Steel – are too busy catering to special interests and mega corporations, and leaving Southern California families behind. Well, friend, I’m running to fight for Californians in Congress, not corporations. But I can’t get there without your help. [**California’s 45th District has been named as one of the most competitive seats in the country so we’re going to need all the help we can get to win. Will you join me and chip in $3 and help me continue fighting for this community?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89803600/488467818/-1902763428?amount=3&refcode=em_fr_2024_welcome_ntl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTFmMmI1YTctZDQ0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HiY0HO5XGNIZGJPcEQ2oHQWIyQXaaNzqdcWouaXvnuk=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Derek Tran will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89803606/488467822/-1905307898?amount=5&amounts=5,10,25,50,100,250,500&express_lane=true&refcode=em_fr_2024_welcome_ntl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTFmMmI1YTctZDQ0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HiY0HO5XGNIZGJPcEQ2oHQWIyQXaaNzqdcWouaXvnuk=)

Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

It has been a week now since the big change in the Democratic Presumptive
Presidential Nominee from President Biden to Vice President Harris. So
much momentum has built already. We are riding a wave of positive energy
and true hope for a Better Future. *Get Engaged*. *Stay engaged*. We are
down to within the last 100 days until the election is complete. October 7
th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this election.
October 21 marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election day!
As a runner, no matter how much energy I’ve expended during a run, I always
manage to give a little extra at the finish. Keep running and hold a good
pace for now. Be ready to really kick it in October. What we do now will
make all of the difference in the quality of our lives post-election.

With that in mind, here is what’s coming up soon.

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

body:
Before Biden dropped out, the Trump campaign was sure they’d win in November, so they picked a MAGA ‘mini-me’ to shore up the base. Big mistake.
|
---
Friend,

JD Vance is one of the worst vice presidential candidates ever. Donald Trump made a GROSS miscalculation in picking him.

The pick was the result of overconfidence. Before Biden dropped out, the Trump campaign was sure they’d win in November, so they chose a MAGA ‘mini-me’ to shore up the base and put a pseudo-intellectual veneer on Trump’s authoritarian agenda.

In case you forgot just how awful JD Vance is, let’s go over some of his lowlights:
* He was a leading Never Trumper who once called Trump “cultural heroin” and “America’s Hitler” before doing a complete 180.
* He’s a hardline isolationist who wants to abandon Ukraine and pull the US out of NATO.
* He stated that he would NOT have certified the 2020 election, allowing Trump to steal it.
* **And many,_many_ more. **

If Trump wins a second term, there will be no Mike Pence-type to moderate him. His administration will be filled with odious suck-ups like Vance who are willing to do whatever it takes to earn Trump’s approval.

That’s why we have to defeat both of them this November. Our country is too precious to be put in the hands of these two.

clean_body: Before Biden dropped out, the Trump campaign was sure they’d win in November, so they picked a MAGA ‘mini-me’ to shore up the base. Big mistake. | Friend, JD Vance is one of the worst vice presidential candidates ever. Donald Trump made a GROSS miscalculation in picking him. The pick was the result of overconfidence. Before Biden dropped out, the Trump campaign was sure they’d win in November, so they chose a MAGA ‘mini-me’ to shore up the base and put a pseudo-intellectual veneer on Trump’s authoritarian agenda. In case you forgot just how awful JD Vance is, let’s go over some of his lowlights: He was a leading Never Trumper who once called Trump “cultural heroin” and “America’s Hitler” before doing a complete 180. He’s a hardline isolationist who wants to abandon Ukraine and pull the US out of NATO. He stated that he would NOT have certified the 2020 election, allowing Trump to steal it. And many,many more. If Trump wins a second term, there will be no Mike Pence-type to moderate him. His administration will be filled with odious suck-ups like Vance who are willing to do whatever it takes to earn Trump’s approval. That’s why we have to defeat both of them this November. Our country is too precious to be put in the hands of these two. Sarah Longwell | | Republican Accountability, 1100 Vermont Ave. NW, Tenth Floor, Washington, DC 20005 Paid for by the Republican Accountability PAC Inc. October 29, 2004
First Selectman George Temple of Oxford has just [endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/eace80bc-a0ee-487d-949f-eeb9ba62a5aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Dr. Michael Goldstein in the Republican Primary of August 13 stating: "I enthusiastically support Mike Goldstein for Congress. Please get out and vote August 13."
And the Honorable George Temple is the Republican's Republican. As First Selectman of Oxford only did not raise taxes on his constituents, he actually [cut them](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d5edf5-dd53-41ab-82bf-ff42c8391ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!
And fellow Selectman and Goldstein endorser, Arnold Jensen, helped him do so. Now Jensen is running for the State Assembly in District 131 and he knows that with Dr. Michael Goldstein at the top of the ticket in our Congressional Race against Jim Himes, he has a much greater chance of winning because Goldstein will bring more Republicans to the polls.
Cathleen Walsh, a member of the Stamford/Greenwich Tea Party, also endorsed Dr. Goldstein. Ms. Walsh was instrumental in obtaining the endorsement of the Connecticut State Lodge Fraternal Order of Police stating:

"When I endorsed Dr Michael Goldstein, it was because he has always been an avid supporter of our men and woman that protect and serve us. But you do not have to just take my word for it, the following is a huge and well deserved endorsement. We need someone to replace Jim Himes that will help restore law and order, and bring back support and respect for our LEO's."

# Healing Through God's Word!!
### Building a Strong Foundation for the Next Generation:
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 29
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Life is full of challenges and pain that can leave deep scars on our hearts. God's Word offers us a path to healing and restoration. Psalm 147:3 "He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds." Through the Bible, we find comfort, guidance, and the assurance that God is with us, even in our darkest moments.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a6024778-24f8-4898-8e61-64f535be11e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As we seek to heal from our hurts, it is important that we immerse ourselves in the Word of God. The Bible provides strength that can help us overcome any adversity. In doing so, we not only find healing for ourselves but also ensure that we do not pass on our pain to the next generation. Instead, we can pour into them the love, grace, and wisdom that we have received from God.
When we invest in the next generation, we have a great responsibility. Our children and young people look to us for guidance and inspiration. If we are burdened by hurt, it can affect how we nurture and mentor them. By allowing God's Word to heal us, we become vessels of His love and truth, capable of raising a generation rooted in faith and resilience.

Building a Strong Foundation for the Next Generation: | | | | Jul 29 | Life is full of challenges and pain that can leave deep scars on our hearts. God's Word offers us a path to healing and restoration. Psalm 147:3 "He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds." Through the Bible, we find comfort, guidance, and the assurance that God is with us, even in our darkest moments. As we seek to heal from our hurts, it is important that we immerse ourselves in the Word of God. The Bible provides strength that can help us overcome any adversity. In doing so, we not only find healing for ourselves but also ensure that we do not pass on our pain to the next generation. Instead, we can pour into them the love, grace, and wisdom that we have received from God. When we invest in the next generation, we have a great responsibility. Our children and young people look to us for guidance and inspiration. If we are burdened by hurt, it can affect how we nurture and mentor them. By allowing God's Word to heal us, we become vessels of His love and truth, capable of raising a generation rooted in faith and resilience. Dan Carr is a reader-supported publication. **WOW.** What an honor to receive President Trump's Complete and Total Endorsement!

My primary is this coming Tuesday and I can't tell you how much his support means to me.

I remember joining President Trump on stage at many Arizona rallies during my 2022 Senate campaign. He was a hero of mine then and even more so today.

You see, President Trump and I have a few things in common...
\- The Democrat Machine unloaded MILLIONS to defeat us
\- The Establishment tried to destroy our spirits
\- The RINOs tried to end our campaigns for good
But they should know something... **MAGA REPUBLICANS NEVER GIVE UP! **

That's why I decided to throw my name on the ballot again, because America is worth fighting for.

I'll tell you this: President Trump & future VP JD Vance can count on me to be the strongest America First warrior in the House of Representatives. **I 'll get to work on DAY ONE helping them Make America Great Again. **

But I can't help get the job done if I lose this election. ")

Zach Rehl is a patriot, and he urgently needs your help.

Zach received an honorable discharge from the US Marine Corps, and a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**The FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen Presidential election at the US Capitol on January 6th, 2021.**

After that, Zach was:

* Jailed in the infamous DC Gulag without bail for years
* Spied on by a snitch, so every move by his legal defense team was reported to the FBI
* Sentenced to 15 years in prison for seditious conspiracy -- a crime he didn't commit

**Well, Zach, his wife Amanda and their three year old girl were just dealt another brutal blow by Joe Biden. His Veterans Administration just billed Zach $93,138.67 for benefits he never received!**

Of course, Zach can't pay a penny. He's in federal prison in Virginia.

And Amanda can't write a check for almost $100,000. Who can?

Maybe Joe Biden expects Zach and Amanda's baby girl to pay that bill!

I can't believe this is happening to innocent Americans in our own country.

And frankly, it makes my blood boil.

**Because it 's obvious Joe Biden's FBI, DOJ, and VA mean to break Zach and his family ... and send a warning to you, me and other patriots who peacefully fight back for our freedoms and our future.**

Zach warned Amanda about this in a letter:

**" They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can't happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you."**

But you and I don't have to sit there and take it.

**I 've filed crucial lawsuits to free January 6 peaceful protesters. Including a critical new lawsuit that proves the FBI and other agencies broke the law by carrying out illegal surveillance on January 6 patriots. That means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.**

This powerful new lawsuit will rein in the FBI, too.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with my critically important new case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

If we win, that means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.

Let me tell you, these lawsuits are very expensive and time consuming.

But Zach and his fellow January patriots and their families are worth it.

Right now, 25% of renters spend over half of their income on housing, leaving little money for other needs and increasing the risk of becoming homeless. In Northern Michigan and the UP, the leading causes of homelessness for families are: Lack of affordable housing supply Unemployment * Low wages High rent and insufficient income make it hard for families to afford a place to live. Housing insecurity is a result of policy choices, not inevitable outcomes. The need for jobs and fair wages is clear. Making housing affordable is crucial to stabilizing families and our economy, especially in Northern Michigan and the UP. Winning a majority in the House is a significant first step in tackling these issues. I have an election in just eight days and need your continued support. We’re fighting for affordable housing, childcare, education, and universal healthcare - especially reproductive freedom. Most importantly, we ’re fighting for an economic system that works for everyone. Join our fight. Every dollar makes a big difference in our ability to defeat people uncommitted to helping everyday hardworking families thrive. Thank you, -Bob Bob Lorinser Candidate for US Congress Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula Democrat, MI01 CONTRIBUTE [] [] Or, send a check to Friends of Dr. Bob PO BOX 936 Marquette, MI 49855 United States Paid for by Friends of Dr. Bob

'Incredible how much things can change': New alliance stoked to get Harris elected
---
#### [USA Today](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWGmjmZ3qiaiGu-PY012mUqJ8uduIPKo6_-gyxDNBcQIWZBb9vsrpZtIPjFymvJSkWRrss44p4S3NuLwP-tndvOMMGAvf8BwHJkBF_Dfprj3ukxI2Dp6-yNDXD3jZX6n6gfkknatcIM1Yn6uGPzHVgS7sqB16tske2Na1f09kvA__wHSbOMV83fAbNiRXGQRkvmOt4TWR7k5HAhO4FAwfrWi6swGPcUCwS2F2TQDxVsSEb_PCtfMfSbspkByiXjUZdejPLK7dYZck-kX4CSPILGw6Uoe1cV3di3S1dFh55a3yjL0AqhGnY_GMBa0GrS4L_Ua9DeIUkHLuAnryJOD3H2wXLeuKhS4ulsEWeKTWQUn/48g/96CDCGlqSa-IfoPwoyTlYg/h28/h001.lSukwa_6_-iNQ5S1QqG-IOMXvXqP86Zkdpum8aWiIto) - _Vice President Kamala Harris is gaining ground with America’s youngest voters, a new Axios/Generation Lab poll shows, less than a week after the launch of her presidential campaign._
---
#### Quentin Wathum-Ocama, the Young Democrats of America’s president, 33, says it feels a lot like the “Hope and Change” vibe of the Obama campaign in 2008, adding, “It’s incredible how much things can change in just a few days.” Hoping to maximize their efforts, Voters of Tomorrow brought together 17 youth political advocacy groups representing tens of thousands of voters to join forces. This alliance aims to bolster Harris’ campaign in the final stretch, according to a statement released Friday morning. The groups are hoping their combined efforts could help get more young people to vote for the vice president this November, a voting bloc Democrats need more than Republicans and that President Joe Biden struggled to win over. Wathum-Ocama said Biden’s decision to exit the race and Harris’ entrance into the race Sunday energized a group of campaign volunteers who weren’t feeling confident about the party’s odds in the fall. “They feel good, and they feel like we can ride this into November. We can ride this up and down the ballot,” Wathum-Ocama, 33, said. “If you had called me last Thursday, what would I have said?”

There are some important updates we don't want you to miss. Stay tuned for exciting news and key highlights! | Upcoming Events \- August 3 - NYC, NY \- August 7 - Trenton, NJ \- August 8-9 - Raleigh, NC \- August 10-11 - Detroit, MI \- August 11 - Holly Hill, FL \- August 13 - Dallas, TX \- August 18 - Chicago, IL Democratic National Convention - August 19-22 - Chicago, IL \- August 20 - Chicago, IL \- August 24 - Maitland, FL \- August 27 - Lincoln, NE Is there a YDA local, chartered unit or caucus event that should be listed in our next newsletter? Email us atmailto:office@yda.org to let us know. | Share Your Photos & Content with YDA Do you have photos of events you or your chapter have hosted? Here at YDA, we love to highlight and celebrate our chapters. Please DM us photos of the exciting things your chapter has been up to. Photos can be submitted by messaging @theyoungdemocrats on Instagram You can also DM us on twitter (@YoungDems) with posts or content you want us to share or boost. Always feel free to email us at mailto:communications@yda.org with any questions or concerns. | Harris for President Campaign Updates | Young Voters for Harris National Call The Harris campaign is excited to share with you our Social Media Toolkit! Packed with ready-to-use graphics, videos, and infographics, it's designed to help you amplify Kamala's message and engage with supporters online. . Harris for President Young Organizer Training Summit The Harris Campaign and Democratic coordinated campaign are hosting training summits for young organizers in Detroit, MI and Raleigh, NC. This opportunity will identify and train people who are interested in working on the coordinated campaign as Field, Engagement, or Campus Organizers. We are hosting two trainings and would greatly appreciate your help sharing the word about both: Would absolutely love it if you could share these opportunities with any partners in the South and Midwest. The more we can spread the word in local communities, the better. Would also hugely appreciate you uplifting within your own channels. | Harris for President Employment Opportunities There is so much at stake in this election and we have just over 100 Days to elect Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the ballot. If you are interested in the roles below, or know someone who might be, please submit an application as soon as possible. | | Young Dems Actions and Partner Events | BCYDA The Black Linkup Welcome to Get ready to keep the party going after the Democratic National Convention with a night full of music, dancing, and our dynamic guest speaker, Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett. Join us on Tue, Aug 20, 2024 at 6:00 PM. Come dressed to impress and ready to mingle with fellow party-goers. You'll be amongst an amazing network of Black public servants, political operatives, lobbyists, and advocacy leaders as we connect at this year's Democratic National Convention. Don't miss out on the opportunity to be part of this epic event. Grab your friends and make it a night to remember at The Black Linkup: DNC After Party! Partnership Highlight: Tour to Save Democracy The Young Democrats of America is proud to be an official partner of Tour to Save Democracy. Tour to Save Democracy is a collective of Gen-Z activists are embarking on a Tour To Save Democracy this July 2024, traveling on a bus across the nation stopping in swing districts to flip them blue, drive change forward, and safeguard democratic principles. . | | | Partnership Highlight: Voters of Tomorrow Text and Phone Bank Join Voters of Tomorrow's weekly texting and phonebanking efforts to engage and empower young voters. Visit and grab yours now! | Young Democrats in the News 'Incredible how much things can change': New alliance stoked to get Harris elected - Vice President Kamala Harris is gaining ground with America’s youngest voters, a new Axios/Generation Lab poll shows, less than a week after the launch of her presidential campaign. Quentin Wathum-Ocama, the Young Democrats of America’s president, 33, says it feels a lot like the “Hope and Change” vibe of the Obama campaign in 2008, adding, “It’s incredible how much things can change in just a few days.” Hoping to maximize their efforts, Voters of Tomorrow brought together 17 youth political advocacy groups representing tens of thousands of voters to join forces. This alliance aims to bolster Harris’ campaign in the final stretch, according to a statement released Friday morning. The groups are hoping their combined efforts could help get more young people to vote for the vice president this November, a voting bloc Democrats need more than Republicans and that President Joe Biden struggled to win over. Wathum-Ocama said Biden’s decision to exit the race and Harris’ entrance into the race Sunday energized a group of campaign volunteers who weren’t feeling confident about the party’s odds in the fall. “They feel good, and they feel like we can ride this into November. name: April Parrott
subject: Cake & Productivity!
body:
This is April Parrott, Neil’s wife. I am so thankful for you – Your encouragement to Neil means so very much! I have a favor to ask. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=6bfdff50a4)
---
| |
---
| Hi! This is April Parrott, Neil’s wife. I am so thankful for you – Your encouragement to Neil means so very much!

I have a favor to ask.

Neil’s 54th Birthday is tomorrow, Tuesday, July 30th. He asked for three things: help with his campaign, strawberry cake... and many hands to fold letters at the new office in Hagerstown on July 30th from noon til dark!

**One great gift to Neil would be a $54.54 donation today or tomorrow**. We can win this open Congressional seat in 2024 – Help us to get Neil’s positive message out to voters!

Would you be able to donate $54.54 today or tomorrow or any amount ending in 0.54, in honor of his 54th Birthday?
---
| [Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=4a76193b88&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday")
---
| | Neil and I have been meeting with voters from Oakland to Ellerslie to Jefferson to Gaithersburg each and every day. It has been an exhausting schedule, but rewarding. (I get tired, but Neil buys me ice cream. That is our deal!)

**To watch Neil interact with people makes my heart smile. **He is sincere, and he cares. This man would make a great Congressman.

If you can fold paper or stick on a stamp, you can give Neil another Birthday Gift! Please join us at the new office tomorrow, July 30, in Hagerstown! (The official office opening will be soon...this is a “soft opening!”)

We will be working from noon until dark – Help for whatever time you can. Stay for 1 hour or 7 hours!
---
| [Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=38b9de0703&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday")
---
| [Donate to Bring Common Sense Back to DC](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=7285f7afca&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to Bring Common Sense Back to DC")
---
| We will have **CAKE & CANDLES at 6:30pm** when we sing to Neil. I hope that you will be able to join us, even for a little bit!

Thank you for caring about our country and for DOING something about it! I am proud to be working alongside Neil for this Congressional seat, and I hope to link arms with you as we encourage him on his birthday!

Thank you, and I hope that you have a very nice week!

April Parrott

body:
Running a successful campaign and winning in November depends on hitting our fundraising goals.

| Hey Peter. We’re still a bit behind on our July fundraising goal, but my finance director told me that if we can raise **$8,539** before the end of the day, we should be able to reach it.

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--for the better. Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,Right Wing Revolution,as a guide for a return to an America where ... We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Peter, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

body:
Never.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1706%2E135344%2E7Orz-x)

Hey friend,
One of the most bizarre things I’ve heard since Republicans announced their choice of Senator JD Vance as their VP nominee is that his background as an Ohioan will help Trump in states like Wisconsin, Minnesota, and Michigan.
Whoever has said that clearly doesn’t know much about Michigan — we wouldn’t support a Buckeye for dog catcher, never mind as Vice President of the United States. Because although Michigan is full of independent-minded voters, one thing can always bring us together as a state: our dislike of Ohio.
And unfortunately, being a Buckeye is not even the worst thing you can say about Vance. He suggested that women should stay in violent marriages, celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade, and opposed exceptions for women needing an abortion after rape and incest.
He also supported plans to cut Social Security and Medicare and privatization to a ton of federal services, among many other issues that he’s on the wrong side of.
Those aren’t Michigan values.
[**So I hope that you’ll join me in sending a very clear message to JD Vance, Donald Trump, and the country at large: Go Blue!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240729-2-900k&t=2&akid=1706%2E135344%2E7Orz-x)

The assassination attempt on President Trump caused me to revisit an article I have had on the back burner for nearly a year, maybe longer. Decades of analysis and watching trends while I was in the military and working with multiple government agencies led me to form sound conclusions about a variety of topics in the world of geopolitics and military strategies. The simple conclusion is that sometimes, failure is the plan.
The information and trends I collected, observed, and analyzed during my twenty-eight years of military service and the five years since my retirement are becoming a reality faster than I expected. I hoped those five years would have allowed me some time to start a new career and enjoy an earned retirement after seven deployments, years in the field, and many trips to hostile areas of the world. Instead, I entered the world of political combat one year before the 2020 election and am now connected to wonderful people nationwide and worldwide. The period from January 2020 to today stamped in concrete what I thought was another sound conclusion; if our nation dies, it will be by suicide, not homicide.
The greatest challenge in all this was to see patterns develop that lead to these clear conclusions while needing the means to share them, provide warnings to the right or enough people, and have them take it seriously. Many warnings I offered to individuals or small groups were taken seriously, but we were all minor players with no voice. I quickly concluded that most people outside of this tiny, trusted group were not ready to hear or act on what they perceived as unwarranted concerns. That was when conspiracy theories had a much longer shelf life before they became conspiracy facts.
Fast forward to today.
The basic conclusion is simple: the level of failure in this current administration is the plan. To put it another way, I'll borrow a more current phrase - Biden's failure is a feature, not a bug.[[i]](https://substack.com/redirect/d3f98e0b-ca0f-4e42-ad19-4d322672cc2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If Harris were, God forbid, to become President, the plan would continue, and it would also look like a massive failure to normal and reasonable people. The same is true for most who would seek the office of President today. Newsome, Shapiro, and Clinton; all would be obedient to the agenda and answer to the masters who pull their strings. They are figureheads in a system that requires ideological purity and adherence. The agencies run everything on behalf of the globalist cabal. They are sacrificial lambs. Joe Biden's advanced age made him the perfect chess piece and an asset to the system that controlled him and determined that he needed to be put to pasture while a new puppet was found. Someone I am positive they have always wanted to move up one position anyway.
**Here are a few examples of failure.**
**Illegal Alien Invasion -** The damage is done, and the plan to flood the nation and change its culture is at an advanced stage. This includes ruining what is left of legitimate elections, as too many states still make it easy to commit fraud. Now, we can only wait for the escalation of criminal behavior and the terrorist acts to come.
**Maximize debt --** Decades in the making, our debt load is beyond recovery. Combined with nations joining alternative trading and currency systems, the petrodollar appears to be in terminal decline. Let us hope not.
**Woke (Communist) Ideology -** To weaken America to the point where it could not defend itself from numerous enemies, the military had to be destroyed from the inside. Communist ideologies had to be planted in the army and get mixed in with the illegal jab mandate to create targets out of patriots and remove them. All the while, promotions to the most senior ranks became based on adherence to the agenda. Obama was most effective at this by removing over 100 flag officers. Finally, merit-based promotions are removed from the equation.
**Wars and rumors of wars -** Nobody has been held accountable for Kabul, and nobody will because they were supposed to fail and show a weak America so our enemies would exploit it. Which started when Russia invaded Ukraine. Also, Iran used its newfound financial windfall to fund proxy terror groups that would attack Israel and draw us into another war. body:
Even Sinclair employees are starting to worry about the clear bias on their networks

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89810778/488492637/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTVjMDAyNGUtZTU0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qHOe1RneuSRDD6F3dHXcmxymgLLHnb8zQwPs4ILhCT8=&emci=91c0024e-e54d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=95c0024e-e54d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Since the late ‘80s, the Sinclair Broadcast Group has bought up local news stations across the country. **Today, they control an astonishing 190 stations in more than 100 markets. **
Sinclair has used their massive reach to put far-right, nationally produced propaganda in local news broadcasts. Recently, that includes a constant drumbeat of negative stories about President Biden and positive news about Donald Trump.
**While many have tried to sound the alarm about Sinclair, a damning new report says Sinclair’s own former top anchor Eugene Ramirez resigned in January over concerns about “the accuracy and right-wing bias of the content he was required to present on air.”**
[**We’ll tell you more in a moment, but if you’re ready to support COURIER’s mission to provide a local news alternative to Sinclair, can you chip in $20 to help us fight back?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89810779/488492638/-593472309?refcode=20240729-EM-SinclairResignation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTVjMDAyNGUtZTU0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qHOe1RneuSRDD6F3dHXcmxymgLLHnb8zQwPs4ILhCT8=)
According to the report, while working as lead anchor, Ramirez was required to read stories made by Sinclair's Rapid Response Team, a national news office that compiles and summarizes talking points from Republican politicians and right-wing groups.
**The report shows that those stories were negative against Democrats nearly 20% of the time, compared to just 2% of the time for Republicans.**
Further, Ramirez reportedly was told not to interrupt or question some of the show’s more controversial guests, like Moms for Liberty and _Project 2025_ creators The Heritage Foundation.
**Here’s why this matters: **
* Sinclair immediately replaced Ramirez with another host, and his former show still airs on at least 70 of the local news stations Sinclair owns.
* Sinclair owns television stations that reach 40% of American households.
* According to a Pew research study, television is _still_ the number one way Americans get their local news.

**That means _millions_ of Americans are exposed to the types of lies and deceit Ramirez warned about _every single night_.**
Peter, COURIER exists to counter the dangerous lies companies like Sinclair are spreading.
While Sinclair has been buying up local news outlets, COURIER is providing a freely available alternative in the form of local newsrooms in eleven battleground states around the country.
While Sinclair uses their newsrooms to inject their communities with propaganda, **we use our presence to fight back against misinformation with factual news that actually matters. **
[**But we can’t do it without your help. We don’t rely on paywalls or subscription models to provide our news, which means we need donations from supporters like you to keep fighting back against Sinclair. If you can, can you chip in $20 to help us out?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89810780/488492639/-593472309?refcode=20240729-EM-SinclairResignation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTVjMDAyNGUtZTU0ZC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qHOe1RneuSRDD6F3dHXcmxymgLLHnb8zQwPs4ILhCT8=)

clean_body: Even Sinclair employees are starting to worry about the clear bias on their networks Peter, Since the late ‘80s, the Sinclair Broadcast Group has bought up local news stations across the country. Today, they control an astonishing 190 stations in more than 100 markets. Sinclair has used their massive reach to put far-right, nationally produced propaganda in local news broadcasts. Recently, that includes a constant drumbeat of negative stories about President Biden and positive news about Donald Trump. While many have tried to sound the alarm about Sinclair, a damning new report says Sinclair’s own former top anchor Eugene Ramirez resigned in January over concerns about “the accuracy and right-wing bias of the content he was required to present on air.” = According to the report, while working as lead anchor, Ramirez was required to read stories made by Sinclair's Rapid Response Team, a national news office that compiles and summarizes talking points from Republican politicians and right-wing groups. The report shows that those stories were negative against Democrats nearly 20% of the time, compared to just 2% of the time for Republicans. Further, Ramirez reportedly was told not to interrupt or question some of the show’s more controversial guests, like Moms for Liberty and Project 2025 creators The Heritage Foundation. Here’s why this matters: Sinclair immediately replaced Ramirez with another host, and his former show still airs on at least 70 of the local news stations Sinclair owns. Sinclair owns television stations that reach 40% of American households. According to a Pew research study, television is still the number one way Americans get their local news. That means millions of Americans are exposed to the types of lies and deceit Ramirez warned about every single night. Peter, COURIER exists to counter the dangerous lies companies like Sinclair are spreading. While Sinclair has been buying up local news outlets, COURIER is providing a freely available alternative in the form of local newsrooms in eleven battleground states around the country. name: Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
subject: Party Nominations, Events, Opportunities for Involvement, and More!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
body:
| | | | |
---
| **RPVI News**
---
|
---
| **State Committee Meeting to Nominate Candidates**
The Republican Party in the Virgin Islands will be voting on the party’s official nominees at the July 30th State Committee meeting. Following the Board of Elections' decision not to hold a primary election for Republican candidates, the state committee approved this new process of voting on nominees in accordance with the party rules.
---
|
---
| **Meet the Candidates Reception - St. Croix**
We are excited to invite you to a "Meet the Candidates" reception hosted by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands. This reception is a wonderful opportunity to meet and engage with our candidates in an informal setting. Your presence will help us build a stronger community and support our shared values.
A minimum donation of $10 per person is requested to support the party, which includes a beverage and light hors d'oeuvres. Larger donations are encouraged to help support Republican candidates this fall.
**When:** July 30th, 2024, 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM **Where:** The Fred on St. Croix
---
[RSVP](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=5718f0830a&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---
| **Calling All Republican Ladies!**
---
| We are thrilled to announce the formation of a chapter of the National Federation of Republican Women right here in the U.S. Virgin Islands!
We are collecting names, phone numbers, and email addresses of interested, registered Republican women on the island and will soon announce the details for our first meeting in August.
Please contact Alexandria Hughes at (340) 277-0572 or via email at [dr.aach@icloud.com](mailto:dr.aach@icloud.com) to join as a charter member and be part of our inaugural meeting.
We look forward to meeting you!
---
|
---
| **Ask not what your party can do for you, but what you can do for your party.**
Political parties built by the people create a stronger organization. It's important for individuals to focus on how they can contribute to the party's goals, rather than solely on how the party can benefit them personally. We are calling on all Republicans who want to see positive change in the territory to consider how they can help push towards victory in November. For any time you can contribute, please email admin@rpvi.org with your name, number, and commitment.
Here's how you can help:
\- Donate\- Volunteer\- Staff one of our offices\- Convince friends/family to register as Republicans\- Get out the vote\- Support a Republican candidate
---
[DONATE](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=0e0ef3a3f3&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---
| **New Website Will Be Live Soon**
We have been working on completely revamping the official party website, [rpvi.org](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=1535876098&e=4f81ceec6f). The new website will be live soon with a complete list of our candidates, events, donation links, and how you can become involved or register as a republican.
---
|
---
| **Candidate Spotlight**
We have requested bios and pictures of all candidates running as declared Republicans. Note that no candidate will be endorsed by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands until July 30th.
Candidates who have yet to submit this information can send it to admin@rpvi.org.
Here are the candidates that got back to us so far:
---
| Ron Pickard, Candidate for Delegate to Congress
Ron Pickard, a Virgin Islander and small business owner, is aiming to represent the people of the VI, not D.C. politicians. With his experience, Ron plans to enhance infrastructure, fix supply chain issues, and ensure reliable power for the community.
---
| Barbara LaRonde, Candidate for Board of Elections (STT/STJ)
Barbara A. LaRonde, a Virgin Islander with 30+ years of business, leadership, and community engagement experience, including in the US Army and radio hosting. With family at her core, Barbara is dedicated to bettering her community.
---
| Sophia Del Rosario, Candidate for Board of Elections (STT/STJ)
Sophia del Rosario, Dominican Republic native and mother of five, has been in the Virgin Islands for 25 years. An entrepreneur for 22 years and a cosmetology educator for 14, she's the only Hispanic with continuous education in both English and Spanish, boosting the local economy. Founder of EBM Academy of Cosmetology and leader of the Latin Women's Association, she's pursuing a bachelor's in spiritual counseling to empower youth with strong values and productivity policies.
---
| Collister Fahie, Candidate for Senate (STT/STJ)
Collister Fahie, born in St. Kitts & Nevis on January 1, 1969, embodies the values of hard work instilled in him from a young age. Over three decades in the Virgin Islands, he earned degrees in Paralegal Studies and Legal Studies, and dedicated himself to education and youth outreach. Fahie's tireless advocacy against corruption and commitment to community collaboration demonstrate his unwavering dedication to public service.
---
|
---
| **National Convention Recap**
Delegates from the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands attended the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, WI, to ensure proper representation for our territory.
The RNC adopted a platform that underscores the importance of protecting U.S. territories including the U.S. Virgin Islands.
The RPVI delegation wholeheartedly supported President Donald Trump, who secured a significant victory in the 2024 Virgin Islands Republican Caucus, leading to his official nomination as the Republican candidate for President.
The convention concluded with a unified Republican Party, focused on its vision for America and the upcoming election.
---
|

You and I both know that every life is a precious gift.

Stop the Biden Administration's radical abortion agenda! | | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. Dear Fellow American,

It's Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Governor of Arkansas.

You and I both know that every life is a precious gift. Yet, the Biden Administration continues to threaten the innocent and the voiceless under the guise of reproductive rights.

Every day, they press ahead with policies that expand access to dangerous abortion drugs and allow abortion-on-demand, resulting in countless, unthinkable losses of innocent life. The danger to future generations, the heartbreaking impact on families, and the erosion of our most fundamental values as Americans are at stake.

But we don't have to accept this reality. There is a solution, and you are a key part of it.

I am proud to join forces with SBA Pro-Life America, the most principled and effective organization fighting to end abortion in our country. By advocating for legislation that serves women and saves babies, SBA Pro-Life America stands at the forefront of this battle for life.

**But our effectiveness relies on dedicated individuals like YOU. YOUR voice matters. YOUR actions matter.**

That's why I'm personally inviting you to join us by signing the Stand For Life Pledge. This is a powerful way for us to demonstrate that, together, we form a strong, nationwide coalition poised to protect life, challenge policies that devalue it, and promote a culture that cherishes the value of every human life.

As a pro-life American, would you step forward today and sign our Pledge for Life? You can do so at the link below:

[https://action.sbaprolife.org/sarah-huckabee-sanders](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=ca3a7c64c3b74a0a9e621ab04813732e&_e=F0ymgm8EzypUx_j7J5ba65GpuZ3ml6_I4pG2qG4-uCfb1zcxkKIcfIKu6aalKCxf-fiVjHJPOXv39dqtpPCpwgOCt_9ESI_BxhcY2RhSqpXE5IGmA3n0dd97bxiXPtcuJlCtOUdVFL2gFtg7BJlUmK-wNK1r42Mu82moPUu9QkTa8m1aR-TroPkbG9lblaX8dkRhsb6ao9Ff617ibaOd__UVmSEFmoU_egSaV2fKVrScIubr7YHmEX1uSpeaFk0Wqg9jsFrFi4b9jEEb4oN58IXSuOpMTGD11mf1gWNS07JiaUwgd1yerhS0cKULVBL3VLP9FRn57PQ6ebZFCHKTEFImtpo56UlorIT4s2D2VR4KWRphrM60e1CVBo8V1Du6)

Together, we can protect the future and build a pro-life America. Thank you for standing with us and for acting on your beliefs - because it's in these actions that change truly begins.

God bless you,

Sarah Huckabee Sanders
Governor of Arkansas

Gordon

body:

Fellow Patriot,

My name is Robert Spencer. I'm an author, speaker, and expert on global Jihad and Islamic terrorism, and I wanted you to know how pro-Hamas forces are taking over higher education.

Recently, the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) blocked me from speaking to their students about Hamas' reign of terror through a Young America's Foundation (YAF) lecture. Instead of supporting free speech and open dialogue, UCLA administrators sided with radical leftist agitators and canceled the event.

UCLA's reason? They said that the ongoing pro-Hamas leftist supporters on the university grounds posed a safety hazard to the students who wanted to host and attend the event.

UCLA should have upheld law and order by clearing the encampments and prosecuting all violators to the fullest extent of the law.

**Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

The organization that invited me to speak - Young America's Foundation - is suing UCLA for this blatant violation of freedom of speech.
**[Give $50 right now to fight back and help sue UCLA!](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=97a1004c3f194159a3af8f929ec2a39b&_e=sBKrhHDOhu4McOXfW0-rofomnOFz5ulhDP0IJ2BWZWmP_xdn2sNq84QmxTtiBZpnRbdSkKR933tgDVGLk4Vk_WVA5eFhqR-0o0-l8KvZvuMlYOdgy2ioodUTeNgub4Z9zHnoasFPhW1vdyr4agLoFaAe1BqYelZDp_0Dxmh2o7iVTCJVOhresJf0a1jbuf-MgOFXYj16To7fIPYGerQdOo4KTyAreibY_TgeDC-LeRXh4i5Zz_f8fPD3cOjEIyp5a3_ELy7yX-PjzW5pVWg5TmieQt905LuhxHeZ6z3FrW4WJv9Oy43JwN29PpvXQl4Zo1AnCJLXD21VHF6CodFBGZEOpNSr4nHVxNQjwuKQk8_V9JVMoNOW-XY5bRRhhzO39EznaIR3ngCJi6hSAbJ3TsoyuhWZ5qnQGScsrgtKzMI%3D)** Colleges are supposed to promote learning and dialogue, **not to provide sanctuary to radical agitators threatening Jewish students and Jihad on campus.** Yet, today, many have become sanctuaries for radical ideologies.

_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Did you know that according to a recent NBC News poll, only 15% of young people ages 18-29 say their sympathies are with Israel, and nearly 1/3 of students say they sympathize with Palestinians?

In another poll, 20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

At UCLA (shortly before I was slated to deliver my speech there), pro-Hamas militants knocked a Jewish girl unconscious and stomped on her Israel flag. And there was no outrage over this by leftist administrators at the college.

Instead, a conservative coming to speak on campus is the UCLA administrators' greatest fear and the biggest security threat!

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

You may have heard of Young America's Foundation as the country's leading conservative youth organization for more than 60 years. YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. YAF promotes your values, such as a strong national defense, individual freedom, limited government, and freedom of speech to large student audiences.

Young America's Foundation is taking a stand against UCLA's censorship of conservative free speech.

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

Here's the secure link where you can quickly make your gift: **[https://secure.yaf.org/ucla-lawsuit-protect-conservative-speech](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=97a1004c3f194159a3af8f929ec2a39b&_e=sBKrhHDOhu4McOXfW0-rofomnOFz5ulhDP0IJ2BWZWmP_xdn2sNq84QmxTtiBZpnRbdSkKR933tgDVGLk4Vk_WVA5eFhqR-0o0-l8KvZvuMlYOdgy2ioodUTeNgub4Z9zHnoasFPhW1vdyr4agLoFaAe1BqYelZDp_0Dxmh2o7iVTCJVOhresJf0a1jbuf-MgOFXYj16To7fIPYGerQdOo4KTyAreibY_TgeDC-LeRXh4i5Zz_f8fPD3cOjEIyp5oCKVumB2UbfAFR2rc0jTQs0eSBG9o9CVxk-oM3fuoEx8qRe4zIQaTOF_CrHij33Efv0fOrG5QcYLLnDa2rAh3UFvwM3ztPms1YGe78LKWVBunJLhlLlLQWmCmTeGFL-_reffccYJM-nnralfcOkOHteBMTR0DQRlFkZzsLUva14%3D)**

YAF does not play around when students' First Amendment rights are infringed. YAF sued the University of California at Berkeley, and won a major freedom of speech lawsuit!

But they need your support right away!

UCLA and every other leftist university are counting on conservatives like you sitting this fight out. Thank you for taking action right now and fighting back.

Sincerely,

Robert Spencer
**YAF Speaker, Bestselling Author**

WaPo: Pennsylvania presidential election results could again take days to count [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072924_3&amount=25]
Team: Do you remember all the cries to "Stop the count!"?
When the polls closed on election night in 2020, one candidate appeared to be winning Pennsylvania. But over the next several days, as officials counted mail-in ballots, his lead shrunk and then disappeared. By Saturday, the other candidate was the clear winner of Pennsylvania — and with it, the presidency.
The protracted counting process left a days-long vacuum that was filled with demands to stop counting the ballots while one candidate was still ahead, declaring premature victory in Pennsylvania and building the false narrative that the mail-in votes were fraudulent .
Even if it was done correctly in the end, the delay was just another partisan tactic by opponents of voting rights in the state legislature to sow mistrust in our elections and an attempt to make sure untold numbers of legally cast ballots didn't count.
Why bring this up again? Because -- unlike the 27 states that allowed for "pre-canvassing", or the counting of mail-in ballots prior to Election Day, in 2020 and unlike the 16 states who have changed their laws since 2020 to allow for counting to begin, Pennsylvania is still one of the seven states that bars counting mail-in ballots until Election Day . This delay will likely cause confusion, deteriorate trust in the process, and make election workers targets for harassment. Again .
The continuing danger to mail-in voting is obvious, Team. Help defend mail-in ballots with $25 or whatever you can right now and make every vote count in this crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072924_3&amount=25]

| Hi Friend,
With less than 100 days to go, the stakes of this election couldn't be more clear. We can only save America by participating in it, so here are 3 things you can do today to fight fascism and defend our democracy.
Make the commitment to be a voter this year. We all know that we win when we all vote. But the harsh truth is that Texas is one of the hardest states in the country in which to register to vote -- and once someone is registered, it's one of the hardest to cast a ballot in. We cannot let that stop us this year.
Today is the perfect time to check to see if you're registered to vote, to mark Election Day -- November 5, 2024 -- on your calendar, and to start building your voting plan now.
›› Start your voting journey now by going to [iwillvote.com](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001lGB_AVfFn7JNDp1Z-h3TgVp6GQ_Wl2fSZAxG-R2yaJuUY7DBxr_YqgolsyLT_5Nb0TCRAA2QMhAS7upNoXp01Mgne5oqmwIViSxdlkGEQe8JxG47sjRFXCv-I_PEs8vN0G2MRW2cyJkyEWfB29Inkg==&c=Tn69rnS4iwWFxgyPcoM0zoNMgbt4neEDt8-301PQ0B_XmFta9KMFtA==&ch=Oa0nV_ZbsC3W_3m716C28KMLwoDL8QjJaR2baS73CHhqQUo1INdeYw==).
Get involved in your own neighborhood. After 11 consecutive terms in Congress, it's no wonder my opponent has gotten out of step with hardworking families here in Texas. Voters in Stuart's district are looking for a new brand of leadership this election -- and leaders like Stuart, who'll make decisions independent of partisan gamesmanship or party politics.
To bring about that change, we need everyone to show up at the polls on Election Day. We all need to show up on the campaign trail, too.
Are you following [Stuart's campaign on social media?](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001lGB_AVfFn7JNDp1Z-h3TgVp6GQ_Wl2fSZAxG-R2yaJuUY7DBxr_YqgolsyLT_5NbhCZGOoOks-aWeoOF_geqAsJtgW9xXY6k1l5BEz6kn34_Nes9HptgvS9xBS-6I-5tAfWk7kmwKCXcQKQOVOiUFTjAjFVeTjUE_F-M_iLrN2I=&c=Tn69rnS4iwWFxgyPcoM0zoNMgbt4neEDt8-301PQ0B_XmFta9KMFtA==&ch=Oa0nV_ZbsC3W_3m716C28KMLwoDL8QjJaR2baS73CHhqQUo1INdeYw==) Have you [signed up to volunteer](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001lGB_AVfFn7JNDp1Z-h3TgVp6GQ_Wl2fSZAxG-R2yaJuUY7DBxr_YquDW_8OHrQUZ7g066Ec5MZ01QsI4_B2P97saGscnbJhMDxGhvVOI8_PRUdkyqsqCIeuQpn1OkoIPifQljj5UerXmLyzW1XFA2mLSmnU14O89RpV-ddTwiRUvZuePyQq1lEuZR6cpDTZCzF_2kKHx2fjLqR3y4WGrWgIJL6sPUeR-4BV2VL1f-c6ONPMMGMCoqmITVNjK-xCB9l58Hf46RG3cCAspwgjoHhX3SL7NVIV2_elSaYWCd8_vGnOzDlDbEg==&c=Tn69rnS4iwWFxgyPcoM0zoNMgbt4neEDt8-301PQ0B_XmFta9KMFtA==&ch=Oa0nV_ZbsC3W_3m716C28KMLwoDL8QjJaR2baS73CHhqQUo1INdeYw==) on Team Whitlow? clean_body: One offers extremism; the other offers opportunity. | | | | Just a few days ago I wrote to you about Donald Trump's pick for vice presidential nominee, JD Vance. JD Vance sums up everything wrong with the Republican Party's full embrace of anti-freedom, anti-democracy, and anti-working family policies. JD Vance supports a national abortion ban with zero exceptions for rape and incest. He's voted against IVF protections and wants to let states monitor menstrual cycles. Dear Freedom Fighters,

I was just catching up on today’s news when it was reported the national debt rose to $35 trillion for the first time. Biden’s open border policies and the Feds ability to keep printing more money will handicap our country's prosperity. It’s no wonder when Americans are asked if they fare better or worse than they were four years ago, a majority yearn for a period before Biden’s presidency with affordable gas, food and housing prices for starters and of course, safer communities.

In the aftermath of the assassination attempt on President Trump’s life, we are witnessing Big Tech use their real-time censorship machine and the other side has essentially crowned Harris to takeover for Biden with the Obama’s blessing. Thankfully, many of us remember Harris’ beyond lackluster DNC debate performance when former Democratic Congresswoman from Hawaii, Tulsi Gabbard, shred (https://youtu.be/WabvabWvv8k?si=nLK4DLtOD6WBjmlh&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) Harris in a matter of minutes on her career prior to becoming a U.S. Senator.

If you are local and want to hear President Trump’s Vice-Presidential pick, JD Vance, he will physically be in Glendale, Arizona at Arizona Christian University on July 31^st. If you are interested in reserving tickets, you can try to still nab one by visiting an event form (https://event.donaldjtrump.com/events/vice-presidential-nominee-senator-jd-vance-to-hold-a-rally-in-glendale-arizona?utm_medium=email&utm_source=ncl_amplify&utm_campaign=240723-vice_presidential_nominee_senator_jd_vance_to_hold_a_rally_in_glendale_arizona&utm_content=ncl-s2dmbd9jHy&_nlid=s2dmbd9jHy&_nhids=7NOwF3Gr&fbclid=IwY2xjawEUz6FleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHUMjDj4-7K7eah59VCb732G_x2une3KcvsIwSXzkuFj85tpzXpYG_ymRAQ_aem_-bYYeZWcK1FXE7IU47vxXw&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) posted on Trump’s website by submitting your RSVP.

My campaign continues firing on all cylinders. I even have tan lines to prove I've been out talking with neighbors in our Arizona summer. Also, over the weekend, an interview I pre-recorded with 1100 KFNX’s (https://open.spotify.com/show/7MPAJBo3p8UK5ufTZkCHxL?si=1d12a420ca954959&nd=1&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) “The Pulse of Arizona” with Bill Brady was aired on Saturday morning outlining who I am, my legislative accomplishments, and policy areas of interest to this legislative district and the future of our state.

I’m proud to be the proven conservative Republican candidate that is helping secure the border, keep taxes low, and support school choice for you.

Funny, my primary opponent also supports Biden’s open border policies pushed by the Democrats. Talk about "uniparty." You can watch the video for yourself right HERE (https://www.instagram.com/p/CHF88gGgwqw/?igsh=MWYxcmczbzZ3MHp4OA%3D%3D&fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAAR0sq_boFPCXP8lC0HdmH2KM7YKfFRDitLhdzZQvoxZ20vzr-HQ0itgVJT0_aem_LTnX1-rnBi7sP3dcEiFvGA&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

My general election opponent has promised to raise taxes, provide government giveaways to illegal immigrants, and opposed securing our border.

For the past year, I have continually reminded you how slim our current legislative majorities are between the State House and Senate. It is imperative we have strong electable Republicans representing us on the November ballot for each position to maintain our legislative Republican majority with the onslaught of out-of-state money (https://azfreenews.com/2024/07/democrat-super-pac-has-out-of-state-billionaires-investing-heavily-to-flip-arizonas-legislature-blue/?fbclid=IwY2xjawEU4j5leHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHVWhFbPoU_xPkEWQPPSXceCOhxytQAxt8Kl2T-rmIHMps_q6pCuV01RIlQ_aem_ZyfWUfwD6vxkKMN6p_g6wg&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) pouring in. We only have a 1 seat majority in the House and 1 seat majority in the State Senate. The party who has the majority not only chooses the leadership and committee chairs but sets the policy agenda for the state by assigning proposed bills to the House and Senate committees. Hobbs has been raising money to oust many of us since she became governor. Your current freedoms and liberties are on the
line.

Legislative Council Lawsuit Update

In my "Capitol & Campaign Update #2" email, I informed you I had filled in for Senator T.J. Shope at the July 8^th Legislative Council meeting to adopt ballot
analyses (https://www.azleg.gov/ars/19/00124.htm?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) Legislative Council drafted for the 11 Propositions referred to the ballot by the legislature. Then, there are three citizen initiatives that have been filed with the Secretary of State’s office. The litigation I mentioned is moving through the courts. Planned Parenthood didn’t like Legislative Council’s neutral ballot language. Last week, a Maricopa County Superior Court Judge ruled in a five-page ruling against us that the phrase “unborn human being” wasn’t an impartial analysis of ballot Proposition 139. Whitten ordered Legislative Council to strike “unborn human being” from its description Prop. 139 and to replace it with a more “neutral term.” This decision is being appealed.

Election Day

Alas, tomorrow, is the July 30^th primary. Polls open at 6am and close at 7pm on July 30^th. If you haven’t voted or still need to drop off your mail-in ballot, you can visit the Secretary of State
website (https://my.arizona.vote/PortalList.aspx?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) to learn which polling location is nearest you. I look forward to finishing strong tomorrow to be District 2’s Republican State Senate candidate representing you on the November ballot.

If you would like to donate (https://secure.anedot.com/vote-bolick-statesenateld2/donate?exitIntent=true&mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) to our final get out the vote efforts, you can donate at our
website (https://secure.anedot.com/vote-bolick-statesenateld2/donate?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

I hope this legislative district can unite after the primary because the democrats are well-funded and organized and even have a few campaign offices open to help them get out the vote.

Thank you for your continued support as we work towards a victory in this contested primary election so we can move onto the contested general election to defend our Republican majority in the State Senate.

Take care,
Shawnna

As we gear up for the November general election, there will be a lot of propositions on the ballot. You can visit the Arizona Legislature’s website HERE (https://www.azleg.gov/ballot-measures-2024-analyses/?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) to become familiar with each of them.

If you want to volunteer this fall during the general election, the state Republican party has been actively recruiting volunteers (https://azgop.com/azgop-volunteer?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) to get trained to become poll observers.

If you want to volunteer with the It Goes Too Far campaign, please visit their website (https://www.itgoestoofar.com/donate?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) to learn how to become more involved with their efforts.

If you would like to help donate to keep our judiciary independent, you can donate to the Judicial Independence PAC at their website (https://secure.anedot.com/judicial-independence-defense-pac/donate?mc_cid=fbac6adcb1&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

body:
Friend, over the past four years, the Biden-Harris administration has made this country stronger, and I’m thankful for President Biden’s extraordinary leadership.

Now, as we turn our attention to November, we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to defeat the MAGA agenda and elect Kamala Harris as the first woman president in our country’s history in November, friend.

Kamala will provide a clear and stark contrast to the regressive vision Donald Trump has for this country. I’m behind her 100% and know that she has what it takes to defeat Donald Trump.

But, we must do our part to ensure that when she takes office, she’s doing so with the full support of a Democratic Senate majority.

And make no mistake about it, friend: There is no Democratic Senate majority if we don’t win our race here in Maryland.

Republican Larry Hogan is already up on TV running deceiving ads, and polling shows I’m neck-and-neck in my battleground Maryland Senate race. If Hogan wins, the Senate will flip red, guaranteed.

We need a huge groundswell of support to pull ahead, keep Maryland blue, and give Kamala Harris a Senate majority. Will you please chip in $25 split between my campaign and Wes Moore to help us reach the Marylanders we need to win the race that will decide Senate control in November? Kamala will provide a clear and stark contrast to the regressive vision Donald Trump has for this country. I’m behind her 100% and know that she has what it takes to defeat Donald Trump. But, we must do our part to ensure that when she takes office, she’s doing so with the full support of a Democratic Senate majority. And make no mistake about it, friend: There is no Democratic Senate majority if we don’t win our race here in Maryland. Republican Larry Hogan is already up on TV running deceiving ads, and polling shows I’m neck-and-neck in my battleground Maryland Senate race. If Hogan wins, the Senate will flip red, guaranteed. We need a huge groundswell of support to pull ahead, keep Maryland blue, and give Kamala Harris a Senate majority. Will you please chip in $25 split between my campaign and Wes Moore to help us reach the Marylanders we need to win the race that will decide Senate control in November? Upper and Northern Michiganders need critical investments in infrastructure.

From infrastructure to broadband, MI-01 and other rural communities just like ours have been neglected in favor of culture wars that do more to benefit politicians at the polls than they do their constituents.

In Upper and Northern Michigan, this lack of investment has led to population loss and leaves our vulnerable elders with fewer and fewer resources to live a life with dignity and age in the place we call home.

I’m proud to have been born and raised in this district and to be raising my two daughters here— it’s why I have such a vested interest in seeing our communities thrive.

Rep. Jack Bergman can’t say the same.

**Today I want to tell you about how homophobia nearly destroyed my life.**

As many of you know, I was _publicly outed_ by my Republican opponent in the 90s.

But before that, in the 70’s, _Proposition 6 nearly ended my career before it began._

**Proposition 6** was a ballot initiative that would have **banned gays and lesbians from teaching in public college.**

Similar initiatives passed in other states and right-wing activists were determined to pass it in California.

If it had passed, my 20+ year career in public teaching would _never have been possible_. And without that, I would never have been inspired to run for Congress.

So as you can see, right-wing hatred of the LGBTQ+ community has _real, tangible effects_ on the lives of everyday LGBTQ+ people. And I’ve seen that firsthand my entire life.

body:
