| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/resign?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0729_kamala_issues&n=1)
---
Peter, After Joe Biden dropped out and anointed Kamala Harris as his successor, we decided it was time to update the chart comparing Jill and her opponents on the issues. But then we realized something that may (or may not) shock you: all we had to do was swap in Harris’ name and picture for Biden’s, because **when it comes to the issues that matter,****_there’s no real difference between Biden and Harris._**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0729_kamala_issues&n=2)
---
The reason why DNC elites hand-picked Kamala Harris as their candidate is the same reason they picked Biden in 2020: as Biden put it to his wealthy Wall Street donors, “nothing will fundamentally change”. A system that simply swaps one corporate establishment politician for another isn’t going to solve our problems - because _it’s the source of our problems_. clean_body: Congresswoman Cori Bush is one of the few leading voices in Congress for Palestinian rights. | | | Friend, Our team is in St. Louis right now, knocking on doors to connect with voters about Rep. Cori Bush’s re-election. Congresswoman Cori Bush is one of the few leading voices in Congress for Palestinian rights, which is why anti-Palestinian group AIPAC has spent more than $10 million to try to defeat her. Now polls show that she and her anti-ceasefire primary opponent are tied. | AIPAC and its network of PACs are supporting Cori’s anti-ceasefire opponent with $2.5 million in direct donations and at least $8 million to flood airwaves and mailboxes with attacks and lies about Cori. As a survivor of sexual assault who had to get an abortion, Cori Bush is a fierce fighter for abortion rights, including introducing bold bills for true reproductive justice. Cori’s****lived experience is why she’s able to serve her neighbors so effectively. A community organizer and public health provider on the streets of the Ferguson Uprising after Michael Brown’s murder, Cori Bush has also experienced police violence that informed her transformational legislation to create true public safety for all. Cori is also leading policies to reform the Supreme Court, which overturned our right to abortions and recently ruled to criminalize homelessness. Cori has been unhoused herself, so she knows how urgently our communities need affordable housing, a right to utilities, and an end to poverty. Cori Bush understands what it’s like to be unseen by our own government, and she’s a progressive champion who we need in Congress. But she needs more resources to connect with more residents in her district and remind people who she is. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, with 100% going directly to Cori Bush | | | | | | | | | Thank you so much. Dear Peter,
The mad blind rivalry of the two political parties is snuffing out the soul of our nation.
This ongoing strife distracts us from our real problems, including...
* Our $34 trillion debt;
* The destructive merger of state and corporate power;
* Our declining health and life expectancy;
* The epidemic of addiction;
* Our dangerous and ever-growing war machine; and,
* The fact that 57% of Americans cannot put their hands on $1,000 during an emergency.

Instead of focusing on these critical issues, politicians direct our attention toward divisive culture war issues such as abortion, transgender athletes, and gun control.
While these are important issues, they pale in comparison to those concerns that are physically hurting young and old alike all across America.
Failing to address these real threats further pushes the United States–and her citizens–into an abyss that we cannot finance or borrow our way out of.
We can disagree on the cultural war skirmishes, but we must, together, face the existential threats to the nation. No one else is coming to rescue our country–You and I must do this together.

body:
My constant reminder of what we need to accomplish this month.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89819207/488521911/1328794144?refcode=ea.d99af266-f84d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.d99af266-f84d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5OWFmMjY2LWY4NGQtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=SQFKCw8m62mk2PoGUKFbhV0ej6RXRrxDNGF3x8-VfBo=&emci=5ac71394-df4d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d99af266-f84d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
Hi there! It’s Dan, Director of Organizing and Digital Engagement at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Look, transparency is everything to me, so I want to pull back the curtain a bit. We email you often about our fundraising efforts — not because we love to watch our bank account go up, but because it’s _absolutely crucial_ to our mission. One of the first things I do every morning is check our online fundraising dashboard for updated contribution statistics — how much we raised the day before, or over the weekend if it’s a Monday, how we’re doing this month compared to last month, etc. I won’t bore you with all of the details (not today at least!), but two of the stats that I pay close attention to are how many individual contributions we’ve received and the average donation amount. This is what that looks like for this month so far: [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89819209/488521912/2105508926?refcode=ea.d99af266-f84d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.d99af266-f84d-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5OWFmMjY2LWY4NGQtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=SQFKCw8m62mk2PoGUKFbhV0ej6RXRrxDNGF3x8-VfBo=) What does this mean? To me, it shows that our movement is truly powered by grassroots supporters across the country who are ready to see some real action on climate. We’re never going to compete dollar for dollar with the kinds of mega-billionaires that Trump and other bought-and-paid-for politicians have on their side, but I believe that together, we can elect climate champions across the country who base their climate platforms on the science, not on who the highest bidder is. name: Reid Rasner
subject: I am Running for U.S. Senate In Wyoming
body:
It Starts Here

** Peter,
------------------------------------------------------------

I wanted to take a moment to thank you personally for standing with me in the fight to bring NEW LEADERSHIP to Wyoming.

Your dedication and love for our country are truly inspiring, and I firmly believe that our brightest days lie ahead. Our core values, like freedom and prosperity, are deeply rooted, growing right alongside our collective spirit.

As a 4th generation Wyomingite, I’ve always known that it was something special to have a family lineage that has planted its roots in Wyoming. Every day I am thankful to live in this great state and all the opportunities I was able to have here.
LEARN MORE ABOUT REID (https://reidrasner.com/bio?utm_source=Rasner+for+Wyoming&utm_campaign=1e8f40d037-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_29_10_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_eec4d13cfa-1e8f40d037-293790413)

As a wealth manager, I understand the importance of fiscal responsibility and accountability. That’s why I’m running for this seat!

In 2019, John Barrasso voted against funding the Trump Border wall. Since then, the Biden administration has purposely left the border open and is borrowing recklessly, burdening future generations, while Americans here in Wyoming and across the country suffer the consequences.

It's time to put America first. We need to:

* Secure the border and reinstitute Trump immigration policies,
* Implement a balanced budget,
* Unleash the American energy industry, starting with oil and gas here in Wyoming,
* Reign in government overreach & spending

Could you do me a favor to get started?

Please take a brief moment to ensure these messages reach your inbox by adding info@rasner4wy.com to your address book, contacts, and/or safe senders list. This will help keep our emails out of your “Junk” or “Spam” folder.

My team and I will be sending you more emails in the future as the campaign trail heats up.

To learn more about our campaign visit: www.ReidRasner.com. I truly appreciate your support!

Reid Rasner

Candidate For U.S. Senate

Friend,

**_I hate to ruin your day, but I have to get this news off my chest:_**

Hi Peter, The magnitude of President Biden’s decision to step down and endorse Kamala Harris is truly beginning to set in. We are on the cusp of electing the first Black woman to serve as President of the United States. Sometimes it’s hard for me to wrap my head around how much progress we’ve made in just a couple of generations. **Peter, I grew up during segregation in North Carolina – a future in Congress only existed in my wildest dreams.** Community engagement has always been a cornerstone of my life, but due to systemic barriers growing up, pursuing a career in politics didn’t feel attainable. **Now it’s 2024, I’m representing NC-04 in Congress, and we have the opportunity to elect the first Black woman as president in November.** Kamala Harris’ presidential campaign is not only inspiring, but it is groundbreaking. As I enter the final months of my re-election campaign, I feel immense gratitude and an even greater motivation to finish stronger than ever. [July is nearing its close, and my team has set a goal to raise $10,000 before the end of the month. body:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29289?t=1010&amount=25&akid=2097%2E52803%2EOd-1Uv ][IMG]

A lot of folks probably don’t know this,
Peter, but Kamala Harris and I
actually go way back.

Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the
last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide
opportunities for all families.

She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our
relationship has helped shape how I view public service.

I often refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she has
always shown up for me when I needed her.

In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County
Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.

I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More
important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the
last.

And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s
first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.

Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s
message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29289?t=1011&amount=25&akid=2097%2E52803%2EOd-1Uv ]Will you please chip in $25 right now toward my campaign's July
End-of-Month goal to help me defeat Republican Larry Hogan so Kamala
Harris has a Democratic Senate majority on Day 1?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29289?t=1012&amount=25&akid=2097%2E52803%2EOd-1Uv ]Donate $25

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29289?t=1013&amount=25&akid=2097%2E52803%2EOd-1Uv ]Other Amount

This whole election cycle boils down to this,
Peter:

Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear,
overreach, and fewer rights?

Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters
who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a
country and embrace progress?

In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question.

Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be
another rubber stamp for it in the Senate.

That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November,
but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state
has ever seen, so we’re going to need a lot of resources. Which is why I’m
asking: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29289?t=1014&amount=25&akid=2097%2E52803%2EOd-1Uv ]Can you pitch in $25 today to keep Maryland blue and help
propel our country forward?

donation will go through immediately.

| | **From the Chairman**
---
| | Last week, Russian and Chinese bombers flew near Alaska and were [intercepted](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=af3836e1542f4c468c79f2b477a38bfe&_e=uP-ya0gnZnwCXr5rzsSKMO5YYdFWv1UHRILpKgBDu4kPuWBYFdj60CSk3AmPRySMs2UjciV9X9vK_aKDjzr32q1ZLldG8l-uqf7801FjWonh7XabLHUWFrHn5woRffliO9NBVlvVV_9OhXNuTQcZnVtga_euhHkuCUFjsuGAwdPwu7Z8NpcOyIqnfK2f7hlQkmSzfEW0pY8LLgNB_HkLdEmFrr_C2-BFiSvoLl0p7H58SuC5HOAxioupHoXYQ78dGjrMY0Gd5nTKOCxqZGsrhXb83TnjL5pIA5wv-CnIOaLEG-xlFrXbvfX-Uxiqj1al) by American and Canadian jets. It is abundantly clear just how far the friendship between Moscow and Beijing is evolving, and it’s entirely aimed at undermining and challenging the US. Our two strategic competitors are conducting exercises in the North Pacific, near our borders, and with impunity. Credit is due, of course, to our pilots and their commands for intercepting the bombers, but we should take a moment and think just why they feel so comfortable flying near our airspace and testing our response. Neither Russia nor China respect Washington or the Biden-Harris Administration. Crisis after crisis, test after test, whether the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan or the spy balloons flying over America’s heartland - the administration has been found wanting and our enemies know this and feel emboldened. We can’t afford this kind of indecisive leadership anymore.

Thank you so much for opening this email and taking a few minutes to read it.
#
Thanks so much for opening this email and taking a few minutes to read it.
With **two days** left until our July fundraising deadline, I wanted to give you an update on our campaign and reach out to ask if you can help us close our fundraising gap. [**(If you’d like to do so right now, please click here to chip in $5 or anything you can spare.)**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240729-1?refcode=em20240729-1-902&amount=5&refcode2=902_21716_M1ynQN&akid=902%2E21716%2EM1ynQN)
Since launching our campaign over a year ago, Sarah and I have been immensely grateful to all of our supporters. Whether you've donated, added your name to endorse Sarah, or signed up for our emails, we cannot thank you enough for your continued support!
But right now, I’ll be honest — we’re a little behind in our fundraising efforts this month and need to close the gap quickly. Here’s why:
**Sarah’s primary election is 6 weeks away, and she’s up against a former registered Republican with a history of running against LGBTQ+ candidates.** And because Sarah would make history as the first openly trans member of Congress, she’ll head into the general election with a target on her back.
Your support will help us fend off attacks and make the case for why she’s the best choice to represent Delaware in the House.
This campaign is about making a difference for everyone in Delaware and across the country, and we’ll need your support to ensure Sarah's victory in September _and_ November.
[**So if you can, pitch in $5 or any amount that works for you to help us close the gap on our $20,000 goal.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240729-1?refcode=em20240729-1-902&amount=5&refcode2=902_21716_M1ynQN&akid=902%2E21716%2EM1ynQN)

This must stop, but that only happens if we raise our voices and the Biden/Harris Administration takes action. The best way to stop a wider regional war and more death and destruction is to enact a permanent and immediate ceasefire in Gaza. And with the Israeli government the main impediment to such a ceasefire, the best way to keep the pressure on is to keep up our calls for an end to U.S. military funding and aid. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/47571?t=7&akid=21788%2E4449941%2ECCuUkD) Folks, it’s James Carville. I’m f*cking steamed right now.

Peter,

By now, you’ve probably heard about Project 2025.

If you haven’t, Project 2025 is the name of the legislative goals designed by The Heritage Foundation for the Republican Party. Contingent upon electing Trump as President, Project 2025 seeks to consolidate power into the Executive Branch and radically expand Christian Nationalist values into every part of our society.

And our opponent, Roger Wicker, is working with them.

**Wicker may claim to be a moderate, but his actions in the U.S. Senate have shown us otherwise.** If re-elected, he’ll be a sure vote for Trump (who he’s endorsed!) and Project 2025’s goals.

It’s up to us to make sure he doesn’t get the chance.
